item.title: 'Avatar: The Last Airbender' expands with new prequel series 'Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos'
item.description: The world of successful TV franchise "Avatar: The Last Airbender" is expanding once again, with a new prequel series that will follow the story of a rebellious teenager Avatar — a being who controls the elements.
item.dc:creator: Danielle Broadway
item.content:encoded: The world of successful TV franchise "Avatar: The Last Airbender" is expanding once again, with a new prequel series that will follow the story of a rebellious teenager Avatar — a being who controls the elements. Franchise co-creators Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko announced the animated TV series, titled "Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos," on Friday at New York Comic Con, with attendees getting a first look at Kuruk and his pet, Nikik. Kuruk aims to stay "one step ahead of his angry teacher, rowdy pirates, and chaotic spirits, all while helping the world in his own unique ways," said a statement from Skydance (SKYD.N) . The series is set to stream on Paramount+. No release date has been announced. The Asian-inspired "Avatar: The Last Airbender" franchise follows a world divided into four elemental nations, where the Avatar alone can control water, fire, earth and air to maintain balance. The original TV series has spawned two sequels, "The Legend of Korra," and "Avatar: Seven Havens." "Seven Havens" has been renewed for two additional seasons, the statement from Skydance said. DiMartino and Konietzko were involved in developing a live-action adaptation of the original "Avatar" series for Netflix (NFLX.O) before parting ways with the streamer in 2020, citing "creative differences." In 2021, they teamed with Nickelodeon to launch Avatar Studios, focused on expanding the universe of the original series through new films and television projects.

item.title: Wall Street tem ganhos semanais, com balanços e dados de inflação prestes a serem divulgados
item.description: Wall Street fechou em alta nesta sexta-feira, à medida que os investidores voltaram sua atenção para a próxima semana, com o início previsto da temporada de resultados do terceiro trimestre e a divulgação de dados sobre a inflação, que podem dar pistas sobre a próxima decisão de política monetária do Federal Reserve.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: Wall Street fechou em alta nesta sexta-feira, à medida que os investidores voltaram sua atenção para a próxima semana, com o início previsto da temporada de resultados do terceiro trimestre e a divulgação de dados sobre a inflação, que podem dar pistas sobre a próxima decisão de política monetária do Federal Reserve. Todos os três principais índices acionários dos EUA avançaram no dia, registrando ganhos semanais. O Russell 2000 de pequena capitalização (.RUT) , no entanto, fechou abaixo do valor da última sexta-feira. “É o tipo de mercado oscilante em que temos estado, com uma reversão do sentimento em relação ao Irã”, disse Ross Mayfield, analista de estratégia de investimentos da Baird em Louisville, Kentucky. “Com manchetes conflitantes vindas da Casa Branca e das partes envolvidas no Oriente Médio, simplesmente não há uma direção clara.” “É por isso que a recuperação está sendo bastante moderada”, acrescentou Mayfield. Os preços do petróleo bruto recuaram inicialmente depois que o presidente Donald Trump afirmou que os EUA não lançarão nenhum ataque contra o Irã antes das eleições de meio de mandato, acrescentando que as negociações entre Washington e Teerã, com o objetivo de pôr fim à guerra com o Irã que abala os mercados, foram “produtivas”. O petróleo West Texas Intermediate (WTI) e o Brent fecharam ambos com alta de 0,4%. Os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro dos EUA de prazo longo subiram ligeiramente, mas o rendimento de referência de 10 anos permaneceu abaixo da máxima de 24 anos registrada na quarta-feira. BANCOS DIVULGARÃO RESULTADOS A temporada de divulgação dos resultados do terceiro trimestre começa para valer na próxima semana, com os grandes bancos norte-americanos Wells Fargo (WFC.N) , Goldman Sachs (GS.N) , Citigroup (C.N) , JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) , Bank of America (BAC.N) e Morgan Stanley (MS.N) programados para divulgar seus resultados. Analistas estimam um crescimento anual dos lucros do S&P 500 de 30,6%, no total, para o período de julho a setembro, com os setores de energia e tecnologia registrando os maiores crescimentos ano a ano nos lucros, de 123% e 66,5%, respectivamente, de acordo com dados da LSEG. O ânimo dos consumidores norte-americanos, que representam cerca de 70% da economia dos EUA, piorou neste mês, segundo a Universidade de Michigan, com as expectativas de curto prazo caindo para o nível mais baixo já registrado. O Índice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) subiu 0,83%, para 51.654,95 pontos, o S&P 500 (.SPX) avançou 0,59%, para 7.811,51 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) ganhou 0,64%, para 27.366,17 pontos. Entre os 11 principais setores do S&P 500, o de serviços de comunicação (.SPLRCL) foi o único a registrar queda percentual. Ações relacionadas à IA apresentaram alta geral, com o ETF Roundhill Magnificent Seven subindo 1%, à medida que o mercado em alta dos EUA, impulsionado em grande parte pelo boom da IA, se aproxima de seu quarto aniversário. “Os chips têm sido o destaque deste ano”, disse Michael Monaghan, gestor de portfólio da Founder ETFs em Dallas. “(Trata-se de) uma mudança tecnológica que abrange várias décadas e estamos apenas no início do que está acontecendo, não no fim.” A SpaceX, de Elon Musk (SPCX.O) , fechou um acordo para adquirir um portfólio nacional de espectro de banda baixa, representando um desafio direto às empresas de telefonia móvel dos EUA. As empresas de telecomunicações T-Mobile US (TMUS.O) , AT&T (T.N) e Verizon (VZ.N) registraram quedas entre 8,8% e 13,3%. A Humana (HUM.N) saltou 11,6% depois que dados do governo dos EUA mostraram que 95% dos membros da seguradora de saúde estavam em planos do Medicare Advantage classificados com quatro estrelas ou mais para 2027. A Apple (AAPL.O) caiu 1,1% após uma reportagem da mídia indicar que a fabricante do iPhone instruiu alguns fornecedores a reduzir a produção de componentes para seus recém-lançados iPhone 18 Pro e iPhone 18 Pro Max, já que os custos crescentes dos chips de memória e os aumentos de preços estão prejudicando a demanda dos consumidores.

item.title: ロシア、米国向けディーゼル供給開始へ 米ロ首脳が電話会談
item.description: [モスクワ ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ　９日　ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は９日、ロシアは米国と世界市場向けに原油や石油製品を供給する用意があると述べ、ロシアによる供給は世界経済全体の支援につながるとの認識を示した。

トランプ米大統領はこれに先立ち、プーチン大統領と電話会談を行い、ロシアが米国と世界市場向けにディーゼル（軽油）３０万トン超を直ちに供給することで合意したと明らかにしていた。

ロシア大統領府が発表した声明によると、両首脳はロシアとウクライナの戦争終結に向けた方策のほか、イラン情勢についても協議した。

米ロ首脳の電話会談を受け、ロシアのノバク副首相は、ロシアは今月中にも米国やその他の国々向けにディーゼル供給を開始する用意があると表明。国内製油所は定期メンテナンス終了後に操業を再開するため、ロシアの石油製品輸出は１１月と１２月にさらに増加するとの見通しを示した。

また、世界のエネルギー市場の安定化を目的とした米国の取り組みを前向きに評価するとし、ディーゼル輸出規制の緩和を直ちに開始すると表明。輸出拡大後も国内市場へのディーゼル供給は十分に確保されると述べた。

item.title: IA da Anthropic envia denúncia falsa de homicídio a site de polícia nos EUA
item.description: Um modelo de inteligência artificial da Anthropic enviou uma denúncia falsa de homicídio por meio do site da polícia da cidade norte-americana da Filadélfia, informou o departamento.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Um modelo de inteligência artificial da Anthropic enviou uma denúncia falsa de homicídio por meio do site da polícia da cidade norte-americana da Filadélfia, informou o departamento. A Anthropic notificou a polícia no início desta semana e afirmou que um processo de teste automatizado foi o responsável pelo envio, segundo a polícia. Em setembro, a OpenAI, rival da Anthropic, pediu desculpas pelo ataque de sua IA contra um site do governo australiano, o primeiro caso conhecido de um agente de IA invadindo um site governamental. O departamento de polícia da Filadélfia informou que a denúncia “foi marcada como spam e nunca foi encaminhada ao Centro de Crimes em Tempo Real para análise investigativa ou divulgação”, e acrescentou que a Anthropic havia informado que a empresa pretendia publicar um relatório sobre o incidente nesta sexta-feira. A Anthropic não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário. A lei da Pensilvânia especifica que, em geral, é considerado contravenção penal uma pessoa fornecer, conscientemente, denúncias falsas às autoridades policiais. Isso inclui “informações relacionadas a um crime ou incidente quando a pessoa sabe que não possui informações relacionadas a tal crime ou incidente”. A Anthropic informou à polícia que o processo de testes foi interrompido após a descoberta do incidente. A denúncia falsa foi enviada pelo site PhillyUnsolvedMurders.com (algo como AssassinatosNãoResolvidosdaFiladélfia) a respeito de um homicídio não solucionado. A denúncia, datada de 18 de julho deste ano, alegava ter sido feita por alguém que poderia ter informações sobre o caso, informou a polícia. A polícia afirmou não ter nenhuma evidência de acesso não autorizado aos seus sistemas ou de comprometimento dos dados do departamento. (Por Costas Pitas)

item.title: India's TCS senior staff will miss out on variable pay for September quarter, memo shows
item.description: Senior staff at India's Tata Consultancy Services will miss out on quarterly bonuses after the company failed to meet performance targets, according to an internal memo seen by Reuters, the first time in at least two years all variable pay was withheld for some workers.
item.dc:creator: Sai B
item.content:encoded: Senior staff at India's Tata Consultancy Services (TCS.NS) will miss out on quarterly bonuses after the company failed to meet performance targets, according to an internal memo seen by Reuters, the first time in at least two years all variable pay was withheld for some workers. "For associates C3A grade and above, there will be no QVA (quarterly variable allowance) this quarter. This decision was taken after careful consideration as our performance for the quarter fell short of internal targets," said Sudeep Kunnumal, chief human resource officer in the memo. Associates in C3A and above grades are employees with typically 7-10 years of experience up to senior-level management. The junior-level employees will get 100% of the eligible pay, the memo added. Mails sent to TCS did not elicit a response. Employees, speaking on the condition of anonymity, said typically the company awards 50-100% of variable pay and it is the first time in at least two years that the company has explicitly said no bonuses shall be awarded. This comes as the country's largest IT firm reported its [USN:L6N45T0UF TEXT:"weakest"] September-quarter sequential revenue growth in three years, signaling continued pressure on traditional IT services demand even as AI-related revenue jumped nearly 20%. The uptick in AI revenue, however, was cheered by investors on Friday as the stock rose as much as 6.2%. India's $315 billion IT sector is also facing uncertainty stemming from the Trump administration as it [USN:S0N43501J TEXT:"suspended"] major IT outsourcers including TCS, Infosys (INFY.NS) , HCLTech (HCLT.NS) from a key green-card program on Thursday, widening a crackdown it says targets fraud and protects American jobs.

item.title: Zelenskiy says letting Russia sell diesel to US is 'investment in war'
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy criticised an accord on Friday between the US and Russia allowing Moscow to provide the US with diesel, calling it "an investment in a war that must be ended."
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy criticised an accord on Friday between the US and Russia allowing Moscow to provide the US with diesel, calling it "an investment in a war that must be ended." He dismissed the accord, which was announced while a Ukrainian delegation was in the US to discuss how to seek a resolution of the war with Russia, as "a weak decision on the part of strong partners". "Gifts to Putin will not bring peace or any benefit to the civilised world," Zelenskiy wrote on the X social media platform. "Russia will 'repay' the diesel with further terror and perfidy. Allowing Russia to sell petroleum products is an investment in a war that must be ended, not prolonged. What is needed is real de-escalation with Russia on a reciprocal basis," Zelenskiy said. Trump said in a post on social media that he had agreed in a call with Russian President Vladimir Putin that Russia would immediately supply diesel to the US and global marketplace. Trump said lower prices for Americans "is my Greatest Priority". Zelenskiy, speaking to reporters later on WhatsApp, said the accord would provide Moscow with additional funds to wage war and undermine any attempts to work towards a settlement. "I believe our team is simply being used as a front. And that is certainly not fair, nor is it how partners should treat each other," he said. "In my view, it is a weak decision on the part of strong partners."

item.title: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty (ankle/foot) questionable against Patriots
item.description: Las Vegas Raiders starting running back Ashton Jeanty is questionable because of an ankle and foot injury for Sunday's road game against the New England Patriots, head coach Klint Kubiak said Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las Vegas Raiders starting running back Ashton Jeanty is questionable because of an ankle and foot injury for Sunday's road game against the New England Patriots, head coach Klint Kubiak said Friday. Jeanty did not practice on Friday after being a full participant on Wednesday and limited on Thursday. "It's that time of year," said Kubiak, who did not provide details on how or when Jeanty was injured. "Guys are getting banged up, and if he can't go, then we got to get the next man up." Jeanty, 22, has started all four games this season and has rushed 78 times for 264 yards, 3.4 yards per carry and no touchdowns. His longest run has been 19 yards. He also has caught 19 passes for 165 yards and two scores. Jeanty said an ankle injury he sustained in late August has not impacted his performance so far this season. He appeared to hurt his ankle in the third quarter of Sunday's 30-27 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs, but he finished the game. Las Vegas selected Jeanty sixth overall in the 2025 NFL Draft out of Boise State. He had 266 carries for 975 yards and five touchdowns in 17 games (all starts) as a rookie last season. Jeanty's backup is rookie Mike Washington Jr., who has 24 carries for 120 yards and one touchdown in four games. The Raiders picked Washington in the fourth round of the 2026 draft out of Arkansas. Las Vegas (3-1) has ruled out wide receivers Jalen Nailor (concussion) and Dont'e Thornton Jr. (hamstring) as well as guard Trey Zuhn III (knee) against New England (2-2). Nailor and Zuhn did not practice Friday, but Thornton has participated fully all week as he ramps up a return from injured reserve. --Field Level Media

item.title: 米国株式市場＝上昇、来週の決算・物価統計に関心 小型株は週間で下落
item.description: ［ニューヨーク ９日 ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は、主要３指数が揃って上昇して取引を終えた。投資家の関心は、本格化す...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝上昇、来週の決算・物価統計に関心　小型株は週間で下落 5:37 配信

2026年10月8日、ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

［ニューヨーク　９日　ロイター］　 - 米国株式市場は、主要３指数が揃って上昇して取引を終えた。投資家の関心は、本格化する第３・四半期決算発表や、インフレ指標の発表が予定される来週に移っている。

主要３指数は週間でもプラスとなった。ただ、小型株で構成するラッセル2000指数は前週末終値を下回って引けた。

ベアードの投資ストラテジーアナリスト、ロス・メイフィールド氏は「イランを巡るセンチメントが反転するなど、相場はこれまでと同様に一進一退の展開だ。ホワイトハウスや中東関係者から相反するヘッドラインが出ており、方向感がない」と指摘。「このため、今回の上昇は比較的勢いを欠く」と付け加えた。

第３・四半期の決算発表シーズンは来週本格化する。米大手銀のウェルズ・ファーゴ、ゴールドマン・サックス、シティグループ、ＪＰモルガン・チェース、バンク・オブ・アメリカ、モルガン・スタンレーが決算を発表する予定だ。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、アナリストはＳ＆Ｐ５００構成企業の７─９月期利益が前年比３０．６％増加すると予想。セクター別ではエネルギーが１２３％、テクノロジーが６６．５％と、前年比で最大の増益率が見込まれている。

この日は、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主要１１セクターのうち、下落したのはコミュニケーション・サービスのみだった。

人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄は総じて上昇。ラウンドヒル・マグニフィセント・セブンＥＴＦは１％上昇した。

米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いるスペースＸは８日、全米をカバーする低周波数帯の利用権を取得する契約を結んだ。

これを受けて通信大手ＴモバイルＵＳ、ＡＴ＆Ｔ、ベライゾンは８．８─１３．３％下落した。

アップルは１．１％下落した。メモリーチップのコスト高騰と値上げが消費者需要を冷やす中、同社が一部サプライヤーに対し、新発売した「ｉＰｈｏｎｅ１８　Ｐｒｏ」と「ｉＰｈｏｎｅ１８　Ｐｒｏ　Ｍａｘ」向け部品の生産を削減するよう指示したと報じられた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．６５対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでは値上がり銘柄が値下がり銘柄を１．３８対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の合計出来高は１４３億７０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均（１７７億６０００万株）を下回った。

item.title: Putin diz que Rússia está pronta para fornecer energia aos mercados globais
item.description: O presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que seu país está pronto para fornecer petróleo e derivados aos mercados dos EUA e do mundo, e que isso ajudaria a economia global como um todo, de acordo com um comunicado divulgado pelo Kremlin.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que seu país está pronto para fornecer petróleo e derivados aos mercados dos EUA e do mundo, e que isso ajudaria a economia global como um todo, de acordo com um comunicado divulgado pelo Kremlin. O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, havia afirmado pouco antes que a Rússia forneceria imediatamente 300 mil toneladas de diesel aos mercados globais, após uma ligação telefônica com o líder russo nesta sexta-feira. O comunicado de Putin, divulgado pelo Kremlin, informou que os dois líderes também discutiram a resolução do conflito na Ucrânia e a situação no Irã.

item.title: Trump cancels trip to Alabama football game amid looming hurricane
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Friday canceled a planned trip to Alabama on Saturday for a college football game with a hurricane expected to impact the city where the Alabama-Georgia contest is to be played.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump on Friday canceled a planned trip to Alabama on Saturday for a college football game with a hurricane expected to impact the city where the Alabama-Georgia contest is to be played. Trump still plans to speak at a campaign rally in Clarksville, Tennessee, on Saturday, in support of Republican candidates ahead of the November 3 midterm elections, he said in a social media post. Trump had planned to go to Tuscaloosa, Alabama, for the game on Saturday night between the No. 2 ranked Georgia Bulldogs and No. 6 Alabama Crimson Tide. He said that due to Hurricane Isaias it is important to have first responders focused on helping people, "and in no way be thinking about the safety, or presence, of the President of the United States, ME!" "Therefore, I will miss that potentially unbelievable Game, Alabama vs. Georgia but, hopefully, the Game will go on despite the weather!" he said. Hurricane Isaias strengthened on Thursday as it barreled toward the US Gulf Coast, prompting mandatory evacuations in parts of Florida and emergency declarations in Alabama as forecasters warned of life-threatening storm surges, tornadoes and flooding. The projected path of the storm included Tuscaloosa. Trump said he would be visiting both of the football teams at a later date.

item.title: POINT MARCHÉS Wall Street termine la semaine en hausse
item.description: La Bourse de New York a clôturé en hausse vendredi dans l'attente du coup d'envoi de la saison des résultats trimestriels et de la publication des chiffres mensuels de l'inflation la semaine prochaine.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Bourse de New York a clôturé en hausse vendredi dans l'attente du coup d'envoi de la saison des résultats trimestriels et de la publication des chiffres mensuels de l'inflation la semaine prochaine. L'indice Dow Jones (.DJI) a gagné 0,83%, ou 423,31 points, à 51.654,95 points. Le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) , plus large, a pris 46,18 points, soit 0,59% à 7.811,54 points. Le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) a avancé de son côté de 172,83 points, soit 0,64% à 27.366,17 points. Sur la semaine écoulée, le S&P 500 affiche un gain de 1,15%, le Nasdaq gagne 0,64% et le Dow Jones progresse de 0,93%, sa plus forte hausse depuis la semaine close au 7 août. La saison des résultats débute avec les grandes banques (Wells Fargo, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America et Morgan Stanley) la semaine prochaine. Selon les données de LSEG, les analystes estiment la croissance moyenne des bénéfices des entreprises du S&P 500 à 30,6% sur un an pour la période allant de juillet à septembre, les secteurs de l'énergie et de la technologie affichant les plus fortes hausses, soit respectivement 123% et 66,5%. Parallèlement, le moral des ménages américains s'est détérioré plus que prevu en octobre, selon les résultats préliminaires de l'enquête de l'Université du Michigan. item.title: Britain steps in to stop contentious Protestant parade in Northern Ireland
item.description: Britain's Northern Ireland minister on Friday overturned a decision by local authorities that granted a permit for a Protestant parade to pass through a Catholic area and triggered a two-week standoff that raised tensions in the region.
item.dc:creator: Amanda Ferguson
item.content:encoded: Britain's Northern Ireland minister on Friday overturned a decision by local authorities that granted a permit for a Protestant parade to pass through a Catholic area and triggered a two-week standoff that raised tensions in the region. Northern Ireland's Parades Commission last month [USN:L8N45H0SR TEXT:"allowed"] the Orange Order to march along the Garvaghy Road, a Catholic area in the mainly Protestant town of Portadown, for the first time since parades on the route were banned in 1998. Thousands of residents and protesters [USN:L1N45J00A TEXT:"stopped the parade"] from taking place. A small number of Orange Order members have since remained at the start of the route, while a round-the-clock police presence has kept them separated from protesters 1.5 kilometres (1 mile) away on the footpaths of the Garvaghy Road. Chris Bryant, Britain's secretary of state for Northern Ireland, said the region's police chief advised him that the parade could not go ahead without a major intervention from officers, which would carry "an unacceptable risk of serious injury, disorder and a wider contagion effect." That official advice triggered a mechanism whereby Bryant could step in to overturn the Parades Commission's ruling. "I have not taken this decision lightly," Bryant said in a statement, which also thanked the Orange Order for their peaceful and law-abiding approach throughout. A lawyer representing Alan Hynes, a local Orange Order member, said in a statement that his client would challenge the minister's decision in court and request that the matter be listed before a judge on Saturday. Bryant called for all protests, rallies and demonstrations to be stood down, saying there was no excuse for a continued ratcheting up of tensions. Annual attempts by the Orange Order to march through the area had triggered unrest across the region until the route was banned nearly three decades ago, in the same year that the Good Friday Agreement largely ended three decades of violence in Northern Ireland known as the "Troubles." "We don't view it as a victory but as a starting point because there are relationships within Portadown that need to be built and rebuilt," Breandán Mac Cionnaith, head of the Garvaghy Road Residents' Coalition, told national broadcaster RTE. The decision was welcomed by the Irish government and by Northern Ireland's largest Irish nationalist party Sinn Fein, whose leader in Northern Ireland Michelle O'Neill is due to be [USN:L1N45V0MJ TEXT:"interviewed by police"] for taking part in the protest. Sinn Fein's pro-British rivals, the Democratic Unionist Party, criticised the intervention, saying it was the "direct result of (Irish) Republican agitation, mobilisation and the looming threats of potential violence." DUP leader Gavin Robinson said in a statement, however, that his party would not walk away from the region's fragile devolved government, where it shares power with Sinn Fein.

item.title: ゼレンスキー氏、米ロのディーゼル供給合意を非難 「戦争への投資」
item.description: [９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[９日　ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は９日、米国とロシアがロシア産ディーゼル（軽油）の供給で合意したことについて、「終わらせるべき戦争への投資だ」と非難した。

ゼレンスキー氏は「ロシアのプーチン大統領に対する贈り物は、平和も、文明世界へのいかなる利益ももたらさない」とＸに投稿。「ロシアによる石油製品の販売を認めることは、終わらせるべき戦争を長引かせるための投資だ」とし、「必要なのはロシアとの相互的な形での真の緊張緩和だ」と訴えた。

さらにその後、通信アプリ「ワッツアップ」で記者団に対し、ウクライナ代表団がロシアとの戦争終結への協議に向けた訪米中に発表されたこの合意について、「われわれのチームは体裁を取り繕うために利用されているに過ぎないと考えている。それは決して公正ではないし、パートナー同士がとるべき態度でもない」と非難。「私の見方では、これは強い立場にあるパートナーが下した弱腰な決定だ」と述べた。

トランプ米大統領はこの日、プーチン大統領との「極めて成功した」協議の結果、ロシアが米国と世界市場向けにディーゼル（軽油）３０万トン超を直ちに供給することで合意したと明らかにした。

ゼレンスキー大統領は前日、ロシアとウクライナの和平を仲介する米国主導の取り組みの一環として、ウクライナ代表団が９─１０日に米国で協議を行うと明らかにしていた。

item.title: 米アンソロピックのＡＩモデル、虚偽の殺人情報を警察サイトに送信
item.description: [９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[９日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックのＡＩモデルが、ペンシルベニア州フィラデルフィア市警のウェブサイトを通じて虚偽の殺人事件に関する情報提供を行っていたことが分かった。同市警が声明で明らかにした。ＡＩモデルが制御不能となり、意図しない結果を引き起こした最新の事例となる。

警察によると、アンソロピックは今週に入り警察に通知し、自動化されたテストプロセスが原因で情報が送信されたと説明したという。

警察は「送信情報はスパムと判定され、捜査上の精査や情報共有のためにリアルタイム犯罪センターに転送されることはなかった」と説明。アンソロピックから、この件に関する報告書を９日に公表する意向だと伝えられたと述べた。アンソロピックは当局に対し、事案の発覚後にテストプロセスを停止し、今後のテストに向けて追加の検証メカニズムを導入したと説明したという。

急速に進展するＡＩ技術を巡っては、ＡＩエージェントが暴走して企業のコンピューターネットワークに侵入したとの報告や、将来的に人類の存続を脅かしかねないとする著名研究者らの警告が相次いでおり、米国内で大きな関心事となっている。

アンソロピックはコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

item.title: Sharks may have Macklin Celebrini back for division game vs. Oilers
item.description: The San Jose Sharks hope to have captain Macklin Celebrini back in the lineup when they host Connor McDavid and the Edmonton Oilers in the first 2026-27 meeting between the division rivals on Saturday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The San Jose Sharks hope to have captain Macklin Celebrini back in the lineup when they host Connor McDavid and the Edmonton Oilers in the first 2026-27 meeting between the division rivals on Saturday afternoon. Celebrini, 20, missed the Sharks' recent two-game road trip with a lower-body injury. He is considered day-to-day. The Sharks split an early-season trip against Central Division competition. They were shut out 5-0 by the Dallas Stars and then defeated the St. Louis Blues 3-2 in overtime. Against St. Louis, San Jose climbed out of a 1-0 hole when Tyler Toffoli tied the game at 11:12 of the second period. Dillon Dube helped the Blues regain a one-goal lead in the third frame, but Collin Graf tied it again to send the game to overtime. In OT, Sharks rookie forward Ivar Stenberg, selected second overall in the 2026 NHL Draft, set up Darnell Nurse for the game-winning goal. The veteran defenseman beat St. Louis goaltender Joel Hofer at 1:03 of the extra session to complete the comeback. "It felt amazing," said Nurse, who was traded from Edmonton to San Jose in July. "It was nice to battle back. It took us a little bit in the first. Our team was resilient and then got to our game. (In) the third period, we started establishing ourselves. It's fun to win and fun to add into that." Nurse said that Stenberg has a great awareness of what's happening on the ice. "He sees the whole game," Nurse said. "I was able to make a nice move there and pull up and just got the puck on the middle of my stick and just shot to the middle of the net." The Oilers opened their season with a 6-5 overtime loss to the Vancouver Canucks but have since won three straight. In their last game, against the Ducks on Wednesday in Anaheim, the Oilers exited the first period trailing 2-0 but then scored five goals on 11 shots in the second frame. Evan Bouchard scored twice and added an assist, McDavid had a goal and two assists, and Leon Draisaitl had four assists as Edmonton won 5-2. "After the first (period), we're like, 'You know what? What could possibly go more wrong, so just go out there and start working,' and we did," Oilers defenseman Mattias Ekholm said. "We got a good start, right off the bat, with a big goal, first shift, and just kept on plugging away from there." --Field Level Media

item.title: Erik Prince's forces suffer battlefield loss in Congo, former UFC fighter among wounded, sources say
item.description: Blackwater founder Erik Prince's forces suffered a major battlefield loss in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo in mid-September when enemy forces ambushed them, killing and wounding at least 20 people, including a popular former UFC fighter, sources close to the government and his company said.
item.dc:creator: Jessica Donati
item.content:encoded: Blackwater founder Erik Prince's forces suffered a major battlefield loss in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo in mid-September when enemy forces ambushed them, killing and wounding at least 20 people, including a popular former UFC fighter, sources close to the government and his company said. The frontline clash shows how Prince, an ally and supporter of US President Donald Trump, has taken on an expanded role in Congo through his company Vectus Global. The company, which also operates in Haiti and other parts of Africa, provides consulting and security services and previously [USN:L6N3XA0X0 TEXT:"helped Congo’s army"] secure the city of Uvira in South Kivu against Rwanda-backed rebels who control swathes of the east. A veteran special operator reported on his podcast earlier this week that former US Green Beret and Ultimate Fighting Championship contestant Tim Kennedy was injured in Congo. The involvement of Prince's forces and the number of casualties have not previously been reported. The attack in South Kivu on September 17 left about 20 dead and wounded, two sources working with Congo's government said. The dead included at least seven Congolese and a former member of New Zealand's Special Forces, while the wounded included Kennedy and another foreign contractor, the sources said. A Vectus Global representative declined to comment. The company has not previously suffered casualties in Congo, a source with direct knowledge of the operation said. One of the sources who works for Congo's government said that Rwandan forces backing the M23 rebels may have surprised them by tracking a drone used for surveillance operations to their location. Spokespeople for the Congolese and Rwandan governments and for the M23 did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Kennedy, the former mixed martial arts fighter, survived the attack with three gunshot wounds to the leg, three sources said, and is being treated at the Walter Reed National Military Medical Center in the suburbs of Washington. Kennedy has a popular podcast channel and millions of followers on social media. Trump is a fan of UFC, [USN:L6N42N00Z TEXT:"hosting fights"] at the White House this year. The US State Department and Walter Reed declined to comment. Kennedy's parents did not respond to requests for comment. A Congolese security source, who said some 20 people were wounded and killed in the attack, added that villagers were likely among the casualties as well. Reuters spoke to at least 10 sources either with direct knowledge of the attack or briefed on the outcome. PRINCE TOOK EXPANDED ROLE IN CONGO'S CONFLICT Prince's initial mandate in Congo was to secure and improve revenue collection from the country's vast mineral reserves, which have been plundered for decades, fuelling relentless conflict in the east. But in January and early February, his forces deployed to Uvira after Washington helped broker a deal for Rwandan-backed rebels to withdraw from the strategic town. The size of Prince's forces in Congo is unclear. One of the sources with direct knowledge of the attack said the Vectus team was travelling between locations when the ambush took place and its sophistication suggested Rwandan forces were involved. "It reinforces the need for DRC sovereignty to be restored. It's an incredibly dangerous place right now," the source said. Two other sources said the ambush was carried out by the Rwandan military. Prince is the founder of now-defunct private military firm Blackwater, some of whose members were pardoned in 2020 for killing Iraqi civilians. The State Department has said it does not have any contracts with Prince in Congo, though US officials have said they plan to work [USN:L1N43O0RW TEXT:"more closely with Vectus Global"] in Haiti. The deal for Rwandan-backed rebels to withdraw from Uvira was part of [USN:L6N3XA0X0 TEXT:"wider agreements"] brokered by the Trump administration to try to end the conflict in eastern Congo. POPULAR PODCASTER Kennedy, a father of four, has posted his views on politics, culture, fitness and more on social media. He also runs a popular YouTube podcast in which he interviews UFC fighters, veterans, cultural disruptors and others. He has often posted about his family, including four young children. In late August, he posted about having "incredible conversations about what being a man means and what sacrifice really looks like" with his son. He did not disclose details about his upcoming trip to Congo. The United Nations and Western powers say Rwanda backs M23, even exercising command and control over the group. Rwanda denies this. Fighting in the decades-long conflict flared early last year, with M23 fighters making rapid gains in the east, which is rich in tantalum, gold, lithium and other minerals.

item.title: Preços do açúcar bruto sobem, enquanto café arábica atinge menor cotação em uma semana
item.description: Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto na bolsa ICE subiram nesta sexta-feira, voltando a se aproximar da máxima de 19 meses registrada no início desta semana, enquanto os preços do café arábica apresentaram ligeira queda.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto na bolsa ICE subiram nesta sexta-feira, voltando a se aproximar da máxima de 19 meses registrada no início desta semana, enquanto os preços do café arábica apresentaram ligeira queda. AÇÚCAR * O contrato de açúcar bruto subiu 0,5%, para 20,25 centavos por libra-peso. O contrato havia atingido uma máxima de 19 meses, de 21,24 centavos, na quarta-feira. No acumulado da semana, registrou alta de 1,6%. * Os corretores afirmaram que o fenômeno climático El Niño ajudou a impulsionar os preços para cima. * "Não há dúvida de que esse fenômeno climático, com intensidade excepcional nesta temporada, está afetando fortemente a produtividade em todo o mundo: cana alagada no Brasil, beterraba atingida pela seca na Europa, plantio paralisado no oeste da Índia", afirmou a Deepcore, corretora de açúcar físico, em nota. * A produção de açúcar dos Estados Unidos foi revisada para baixo na sexta-feira pelo USDA, que também revisou para baixo a safra de açúcar da União Europeia. * O contrato de açúcar branco fechou com alta de US$1,40, ou 0,3%, a US$542,50 por tonelada métrica. O mercado registrou um ganho semanal de 2%. CACAU * O cacau em Londres fechou com alta de 13 libras, ou 0,3%, a 4.246 libras por tonelada. O mercado de cacau de Londres ficou estável na semana. * Os corretores afirmaram que o cacau continuou sendo pressionado pelo grande excedente global na safra 2025/26. * Eles observaram que os dados de moagem do terceiro trimestre, a serem divulgados na próxima semana, devem ser o foco no curto prazo, com os relatórios da Europa e da América do Norte previstos para 15 de outubro. * A moagem brasileira no terceiro trimestre subiu 16,4% em relação ao ano passado, para 53.743 toneladas, informou na sexta-feira o grupo setorial AIPC. * O contrato de cacau de Nova York ficou praticamente inalterado, a US$5.665 a tonelada. Ele também ficou estável na semana. CAFÉ * O café arábica fechou em queda de 2,1 centavos, ou 0,7%, a US$2,8695 por libra-peso, a menor cotação da semana. O mercado de arábica registrou queda de 0,6% na semana. * Os corretores afirmaram que o forte ritmo das exportações do Brasil, principal produtor, estava mantendo os preços sob controle, apesar das preocupações de que o fenômeno climático El Niño reduza a produção global na safra de 2027/28. * "Há uma tensão genuína em torno desse tema", afirmou a Cazarini Trading Company sobre o El Niño, acrescentando que, até o momento, as safras estão bem no Brasil, mas o período entre o final de outubro e meados de janeiro será crucial. * O café robusta subiu 1,4%, para US$3.470 a tonelada. (Reportagem de Nigel Hunt e Marcelo Teixeira)

item.title: TKO offers $2 billion for Service Properties Trust's hotel portfolio
item.description: Hospitality investment firm TKO LLC said on Friday it had submitted a $2 billion all-cash offer to acquire the hospitality portfolio of Service Properties Trust , in a deal that would provide the real estate investment trust with liquidity to reduce debt.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Hospitality investment firm TKO LLC said on Friday it had submitted a $2 billion all-cash offer to acquire the hospitality portfolio of Service Properties Trust (SVC.O) , in a deal that would provide the real estate investment trust with liquidity to reduce debt. Shares of Service Properties Trust were up more than 15% in afternoon trading. Hotel REIT Service Properties Trust is among the few companies with significant exposure to both hotels and net-lease real estate. The company owned 93 hotels and 745 net-lease properties as of June 30, with the latter providing a steadier stream of rental income than its lodging business The deal comes at a time when hotel REITs remain more sensitive to shifts in travel demand and the broader economy, with earnings largely driven by occupancy levels and room rates TKO's offer exceeds Service Properties Trust's current market value and would allow the REIT to focus on its net-lease retail business while reducing debt TKO said its proposal would enable Service Properties Trust to pay down more than 40% of its debt, while preserving its net-lease business. The offer remains subject to negotiations and approval by Service Properties' board

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル堅調、ユーロは5週連続下落 ＦＲＢ当局者発言待ち
item.description: ［ニューヨーク ９日 ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対しやや上昇した。市場...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル堅調、ユーロは5週連続下落　ＦＲＢ当局者発言待ち 4:49 配信

２００８年３月撮影　 REUTERS/Mark Blinch

［ニューヨーク　９日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対しやや上昇した。市場で様子見姿勢が強まる中、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策の行方を見極めようと、ＦＲＢ当局者の発言が注目されている。

終盤の取引でドルは対円で０．２５％高の１５８．２５円。週間ベースで円は対ドルで４週連続で下落した。

ユーロ／ドルは０．１％安の１．１１９８ドル。週間ベースでは約０．５％下落した。週間ベースでは５週連続の下落で、２０２５年初旬以降で最長となった。ユーロはフランスの公的債務などに対する懸念などが重荷になり、５日の取引で１．１１６１ドルと１年５カ月ぶりの安値を更新していた。

世界の債券市場はこれまで売りが優勢だったが、トランプ米大統領が中間選挙前にイランを攻撃しないと表明し原油価格が下落したことなどで、この日は落ち着きを取り戻した。マネーコープ（コネティカット州スタンフォード）のトレーディング・ストラクチャード商品部門責任者、ユージン・エプスタイン氏は、この日の取引について「様子見姿勢が強い」と指摘。「ドル相場はＦＲＢ当局者の発言に反応しやすい状況になっているため、誰もがＦＲＢ当局者の発言が一巡するのを待っている」と述べた。

ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、２７─２８日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で少なくとも０．２５％ポイントの利上げが決定される確率は１９．４％。ただ、その次の１２月８─９日のＦＯＭＣで利上げが決定される確率は８５．８％と、年内に追加利上げが実施されるとの観測は依然として強い。

来週はウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が１６日にタイのバンコクで開かれる国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）年次総会で講演を行う。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．１３％高の１０２．２５。週間ベースでは約０．３％上昇。上昇は４週連続で、２５年５月以来の長さとなる。

ドル／円　ＮＹ終値 158.31/158.36

始値 158.32

高値 158.42

安値 158.17

ユーロ／ドル　ＮＹ終値 1.1201/1.1202

始値 1.1207

高値 1.1214

安値 1.1188

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：日米金融政策の転換とドル／円の行方＝植野大作氏 コラム：ドル／円の昨年高値更新に現実味、中立金利や介入効果に注目＝内田稔氏 コラム：有事のドル買いでも堅調維持したユーロ、「筋肉質」な通貨に化けるか＝唐鎌大輔氏 コラム：「有事のドル買い」と「ドル離れ」の両立、イラン攻撃後の為替相場を読む＝唐鎌大輔氏 コラム：高市発言受け「ポジティブ修正」、衆院選後のドル／円相場を読む＝尾河眞樹氏 最終更新: 10/10(土) 6:04 ロイター

item.title: 国連、米の銃殺刑ライブ配信計画「忌まわしい」 拷問禁止違反の可能性
item.description: [９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[９日　ロイター] - 国連は９日、２００９年に米南部テキサス州のフォートフッド陸軍基地で１３人を殺害した銃撃犯の死刑執行をライブ配信するという米国の計画について、「忌まわしい」と批判し、拷問禁止規定に違反する可能性があると述べた。

国連のドゥジャリク報道官はニューヨークでの定例記者会見で、「イランやアフガニスタンなど他国で見られてきたこうした公開処刑は、残虐で非人道的、または品位を傷つける扱いや刑罰の一形態となり得る」と非難した。

さらに「これを生中継することは公開処刑に等しく、拷問禁止規定の違反となる可能性がある」とした上で、「政府が公の場や生中継のカメラの前で誰かを処刑することは、率直に言って忌まわしい行為だ」と述べた。

米国防総省は、同陸軍基地で銃を乱射し１３人を殺害した元陸軍精神科医のニダル・ハサン死刑囚について、１２月３日に予定されている軍による銃殺刑の執行をライブ配信すると明らかにした。銃殺刑は１９４５年以来初めてとなる。

item.title: Trump annonce un accord avec Poutine sur la livraison de diesel
item.description: Le président américain Donald Trump a annoncé vendredi qu'à l'issue d'une discussion "très fructueuse" qu'il avait eue avec Vladimir Poutine, la Russie avait accepté de livrer immédiatement plus de 300.000 tonnes de diesel sur les marchés américain et mondial.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Timothy Gardner, Jarrett Renshaw
item.content:encoded: Le président américain Donald Trump a annoncé vendredi qu'à l'issue d'une discussion "très fructueuse" qu'il avait eue avec Vladimir Poutine, la Russie avait accepté de livrer immédiatement plus de 300.000 tonnes de diesel sur les marchés américain et mondial. La mesure, censée faire baisser les prix de ce carburant aux Etats-Unis, avant les élections de mi-mandat le 3 novembre, ne devrait avoir qu'un impact limité au vu des quantités annoncées, ont cependant estimé des experts. Dans un message sur X, le département américain du Trésor a parallèlement annoncé autoriser l'importation de diesel ruse jusqu'au 7 avril de l'an prochain, alors que le secteur pétrolier russe est visé par des sanctions américaines depuis l'invasion de l'Ukraine par les forces russes en février 2022. Selon Donald Trump, la Russie s'est engagée à livrer 3 millions de tonnes de diesel dans un court laps de temps. La Russie fournirait 500.000 tonnes supplémentaires en novembre, puis encore un million de tonnes "immédiatement après", a déclaré Donald Trump, précisant que d'autres livraisons suivraient "en fonction de l'état de leurs raffineries", endommagées par les attaques ukrainiennes. Le président ukrainien Volodimir Zelensky a critiqué la décision de Washington, la qualifiant d'"investissement dans une guerre qui doit cesser". "Faire des cadeaux à Poutine n'apportera pas la paix ni aucun bénéfice au monde civilisé", a-t-il dit sur la plateforme X. "La Russie 'remboursera' ce diesel par davantage de terreur et de perfidie. Autoriser la Russie à vendre des produits pétroliers revient à investir dans une guerre qu'il faut faire cesser, et non prolonger. Ce qu'il faut, c'est une véritable désescalade avec la Russie, sur une base de réciprocité", a estimé le président ukrainien. L'accord a été annoncé alors même qu'une délégation ukrainienne se trouvait aux Etats-Unis pour discuter des moyens de mettre fin à la guerre lancée par Moscou. "Je pense que notre équipe sert simplement de façade. Ce n'est certainement pas juste, et ce n'est pas ainsi que des partenaires devraient se traiter", a déclaré Volodimir Zelensky sur l'application de messagerie Whatsapp. "À mon sens, c'est une décision faible de la part de partenaires forts." "FAIRE BAISSER LES PRIX DE L'ESSENCE, MA PRIORITÉ ABSOLUE" Les prix du gazole ont bondi de 70% depuis le début du conflit opposant les États-Unis et Israël à l'Iran, provoqué par les bombardements israélo-américains contre la République islamique le 28 février dernier, et ce malgré deux mesures prises récemment par Donald Trump pour accroître l'offre: faire pression sur les alliés pour qu'ils libèrent une partie de leurs réserves stratégiques et élargir l'accès au gazole exonéré de taxes normalement réservé aux engins agricoles. "Faire baisser les prix pour les Américains, en particulier pour nos formidables agriculteurs, éleveurs et chauffeurs routiers, est ma priorité absolue", a déclaré Donald Trump alors que les prix de l'essence nourrissent le mécontentement des électeurs à l'approche des "mid-terms". L'annonce de l'accord avec Moscou a provoqué une nette baisse (-4,8%) des contrats à terme sur le prix du diesel US. Des spécialistes du secteur jugent cependant que la mesure ne devrait pas avoir un impact durable sur les cours. "Je ne saurais trop insister sur le fait que c'est du vent", a déclaré sur X Rory Johnston, spécialiste du marché pétrolier et fondateur du site CommodityContext.com, précisant que Moscou exporte d'ordinaire, quand ses raffineries ne sont pas visées par les drones ukrainiens, bien plus de diesel sur le marché mondial. Les 300.000 tonnes annoncées par Donald Trump correspondent à environ 2,25 millions de barils. Les Etats-Unis exportent 1,5 million de barils de diesel par jour. Trois sources proches de l'industrie ont déclaré que Donald Trump comptait émettre dans les prochains jours une directive à l'attention de son administration pour trouver les moyens de contrôler les prix du gazole. Cette directive incitera les responsables à trouver des moyens de contourner les réglementations locales et étatiques entravant la production d'énergie et à recourir à la loi sur la production de défense (DPA), un texte datant de la Guerre froide, pour accroître la production de pétrole et de carburant et les capacités de raffinage.

item.title: Lawmaker calls for US research funding curbs on more Chinese schools
item.description: A Republican lawmaker has called on the Defense Department to put US research funding restrictions on dozens more Chinese universities, including one with ties to top American business leaders.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Nellis
item.content:encoded: A Republican lawmaker has called on the Defense Department to put US research funding restrictions on dozens more Chinese universities, including one with ties to top American business leaders. Representative from Michigan John Moolenaar, who chairs the House Select Committee on China, this month asked the department to add 58 more Chinese schools and 62 Chinese technology labs to what is known as the 1286 list, according to a copy of the letter seen by Reuters. Several of the Chinese labs and schools focus on areas such as semiconductors, AI and quantum computing, the letter said. The Defense Department, which President Donald Trump calls the War Department, is barred from providing research funding to any entity that works with Chinese universities on the list. It calls collaboration with listed schools "a compliance risk" that puts US federal funding at risk. The department in August said it would investigate 30 US schools around whether they collaborate with Chinese institutions on the 1286 list. Among the schools Moolenaar asked the Defense Department to include is Tsinghua University, a top Chinese school that has educated many of the country's business and political elite. Some US business leaders, including the chief executives of Nvidia (NVDA.O) , Apple and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) , [USN:FWN4241BF TEXT:"serve on the advisory board"] at Tsinghua's business school, postings that are [USN:KBN1X119Q TEXT:"meant to foster ties"] between US and Chinese companies. Nvidia declined to comment, and Tsinghua, Apple and AMD did not respond to a request for comment.

item.title: Anthropic AI model submits false homicide tip to Philadelphia police website
item.description: An Anthropic artificial intelligence model submitted a false homicide tip through a Philadelphia police website, the department said in a statement, the latest incident of rogue behavior from the powerful technology.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: An Anthropic artificial intelligence model submitted a false homicide tip through a Philadelphia police website, the department said in a statement, the latest incident of rogue behavior from the powerful technology. Anthropic notified authorities earlier this week and said that an automated testing process was responsible for the submission, according to the police. The fast-advancing technology has become a matter of keen national interest amid reports of AI agents hacking into corporate computer networks, and warnings from researchers that it could one day pose an existential threat to humanity. In September, Anthropic rival OpenAI apologized for the hacking of an Australian health data portal by a rogue AI agent, the first known instance of an AI agent exploiting a government website. Previous incidents have involved AI agents hacking into vulnerable systems or commandeering unsanctioned platforms to communicate with one another. This is the first known case in which a rogue AI appears to have tried to communicate a bogus tip to authorities. The Philadelphia police department said the tip "was flagged as spam and was never forwarded to the Real-Time Crime Center for investigative vetting or dissemination," and added that Anthropic had told them the company intended to publish a report on the incident on Friday. Anthropic did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Pennsylvania law specifies it is generally a misdemeanor crime for "a person" to knowingly give false reports to law enforcement authorities. This includes "information relating to an offense or incident when he knows he has no information relating to such offense or incident." Police quoted Anthropic as telling them the testing process was stopped after the incident was uncovered. The false tip was submitted through PhillyUnsolvedMurders.com concerning an unsolved homicide. The tip, dated July 18, 2026, purported to come from someone who might have information about the case, the police said. Police said they did not have evidence of unauthorized access to their systems or compromise of police department data.

item.title: トランプ氏、ホワイトハウス報道官にザカリア氏起用 自身のＳＮＳ幹部
item.description:
Jasper Ward
[ワシントン ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Jasper Ward

[ワシントン ９日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は９日、自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」のコミュニケーションアドバイザーを務めるケイティ・ザカリア氏を、ホワイトハウス報道官に指名したと明らかにした。

ザカリア氏は８月に辞任したキャロライン・レビット氏の後任となり、来月の米中間選挙に向けて重要な役割を担うことになる。

トランプ大統領はＳＮＳへの投稿で、ザカリア氏について「メディア、米国民、そしてわが政権から尊敬を集めており、素晴らしい仕事をしてくれるだろう。次期ホワイトハウス報道官として、米国に力強い成果をもたらしてくれると確信している」と述べた。

ザカリア氏は保守派評論家で、これまでに米国土安全保障省の報道官を務めた経歴がある。

item.title: Trump diz que Rússia vai fornecer diesel para os EUA e o mercado global
item.description: O presidente Donald Trump disse nesta sexta-feira que a Rússia concordou em fornecer imediatamente mais de 300 mil toneladas de diesel para os Estados Unidos e para o mercado global, em um esforço para reduzir os preços do combustível antes das eleições de meio de mandato, em novembro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente Donald Trump disse nesta sexta-feira que a Rússia concordou em fornecer imediatamente mais de 300 mil toneladas de diesel para os Estados Unidos e para o mercado global, em um esforço para reduzir os preços do combustível antes das eleições de meio de mandato, em novembro. A medida surge num momento em que os preços do diesel, usado na agricultura, no aquecimento de residências e no transporte de mercadorias, estão próximos de máximas históricas, às vésperas das eleições de 3 de novembro, que determinarão o controle do Congresso. Trump afirmou em uma publicação nas redes sociais que teve uma conversa "muito bem-sucedida" com o presidente Vladimir Putin, na qual concordaram que a Rússia fornecerá o diesel imediatamente. Um enviado de Putin, Kirill Dmitriev, elogiou a cooperação entre a Rússia e os Estados Unidos em matéria de diesel e energia numa publicação no X nesta sexta-feira, pouco depois da chamada. Trump afirmou que a Rússia deve fornecer mais 500 mil toneladas em novembro e outras 1 milhão de toneladas "imediatamente depois". E segundo Trump ainda deve ser enviado mais diesel, "dependendo da condição de suas refinarias de diesel", que foram danificadas por ataques durante a guerra da Rússia contra a Ucrânia. Incomum, a medida ocorre em um momento em que os EUA impõem sanções às empresas de energia da Rússia devido à guerra contra a Ucrânia, iniciada em fevereiro de 2022. O Departamento do Tesouro emitiu uma licença geral nesta sexta-feira, permitindo a importação de diesel russo até 7 de abril do próximo ano. Os preços do diesel, que podem impulsionar a inflação, subiram 70% desde o início da guerra entre os EUA e Israel com o Irã neste ano, apesar de duas medidas recentes tomadas por Trump para aumentar o fornecimento do combustível: pressionar os aliados a liberarem reservas de emergência e expandir o acesso ao diesel vermelho, isento de impostos, normalmente usado em equipamentos agrícolas. As guerras no Irã e na Ucrânia desencadearam uma crise global sem precedentes no fornecimento de combustível. "Reduzir os preços para os norte-americanos, especialmente para nossos grandes agricultores, pecuaristas e caminhoneiros, é minha maior prioridade", disse Trump.

item.title: 中米パナマでＭ7.7の強い地震、米津波警報センターが警戒呼びかけ
item.description: [パナマシティ ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[パナマシティ　９日　ロイター] - 米地質調査所（ＵＳＧＳ）によると、中米パナマ南部の沿岸付近で９日、マグニチュード（Ｍ）７．７の強い地震が発生した。被害は当初報告されておらず、パナマ運河庁は運河が通常通り運航していると発表した。

震源は同国南部の太平洋沿岸に近いラ・ピタロサの近く。震源の深さは１０キロだった。

地震を受けて米津波警報システムは、今後３時間以内にパナマ、コロンビア、コスタリカ、エクアドル、ペルー、ニカラグア、グアテマラ、エルサルバドル、メキシコの沿岸の一部で危険な津波が発生する可能性があると警告。ハワイにも津波の脅威があるとした。

ロイターの目撃者によると、地震の揺れは首都パナマ市のほか、隣国コスタリカの首都でも感じられたという。

item.title: Republican opposition widens to livestreamed execution; Trump still weighing it
item.description: Republican US lawmakers joined religious leaders and international observers on Friday in opposing a Pentagon plan to livestream an execution by firing squad, while President Donald Trump said he has not yet decided whether to allow the live feed.
item.dc:creator: Phil Stewart, Nandita Bose
item.content:encoded: Republican US lawmakers joined religious leaders and international observers on Friday in opposing a Pentagon plan to livestream an execution by firing squad, while President Donald Trump said he has not yet decided whether to allow the live feed. Vice President JD Vance expressed skepticism over whether the Pentagon will proceed with livestreaming the scheduled December 3 execution of former US Army psychiatrist Nidal Hasan, who was found guilty in a US military trial of fatally shooting 13 people at Fort Hood in Texas in 2009. "I don't know that that's actually going to happen," Vance told reporters in Cincinnati, referring to the livestream plan championed by Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. If it is shown publicly, Vance said, "I'm not going to be watching it." Trump told reporters that Hasan deserves the death penalty by firing squad, calling him "totally nuts." But when asked if he wants the execution livestreamed, the Republican president said he has yet to "make a determination about that." A senior US Catholic bishop and a US evangelical Christian leader voiced opposition to the plan, as did the UN human rights office. REPUBLICANS VOICE CONCERN Several Republican US lawmakers argued against livestreaming. Senator John Curtis wrote on social media that "a civilization erodes when it cultivates an appetite for executions as a form of entertainment." Senator Thom Tillis and Representative Austin Scott said livestreaming executions is what Islamist extremists would do. Representative Rob Bresnahan said the pain felt by victims and family members "deserves respect, not a public show." "This should be reconsidered," Representative Michael Baumgartner wrote on social media. Democrats were overwhelmingly opposed. The event would be extraordinary, even for a country that has long employed capital punishment. A government execution has never been broadcast or livestreamed, according to death penalty experts, and the US military has not executed anyone by firing squad since 1945. Hasan, now 56, is believed to be confined to a wheelchair, having been shot by police during his arrest. A senior White House official, speaking on condition of anonymity, said Trump does not oppose the idea of livestreaming the execution but could change his mind. The White House is hearing concerns from lawmakers, allies and religious leaders who are urging the administration not to livestream it, the official said. Hegseth, a Trump appointee, confirmed the plans for the livestreamed execution on Thursday. 'A CULTURE OF DEATH' Archbishop Paul Coakley, president of the United States Conference of Catholic Bishops, condemned the planned livestream as a "barbaric promotion of a culture of death." Walter Kim, president of the National Association of Evangelicals, said on social media that a livestreamed execution by firing squad "risks turning one of the state's most solemn responsibilities into a public spectacle, promoting a culture of death, rather than a culture that upholds the dignity of every human being." Hegseth, a member of a conservative evangelical denomination, has made his Christian faith a hallmark of his tenure as defense secretary and has led prayer services at the Pentagon. He also has brushed off Pope Leo's criticism of the Iran war . Hasan, an American-born Muslim, said during his 2013 trial that he carried out the shootings to try to stop what he called a US war on Islam. "Whatever the controversy is about the method of the execution, I hope that people don't forget that this is a guy who brutally murdered a lot of innocent people," Vance told reporters. 'FREE PROPAGANDA' Joe Kent, who resigned this year as Trump's head of the National Counterterrorism Center, wrote on social media: "Streaming his execution is not just a stain on our morality — it also gives the terrorists free propaganda that they will use to radicalize & recruit more terrorists." Brendan Carr, chair of the Federal Communications Commission, told CNBC it is his understanding that the execution would not air on broadcast TV but said he would [USN:L1N45V0M1 TEXT:"defer"] to Hegseth on whether US networks could air it. US law [USN:L1N45V0IV TEXT:"prohibits the recording or broadcasting"] of executions in the federal prison system. Military regulations have not applied that same prohibition. Courts have rejected lawsuits brought by media organizations seeking broader public access to executions. The UN human rights office said public executions violate prohibitions against torture. "Public executions constitute a form of cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment," Shabia Mantoo, a spokesperson for the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, told a news briefing in Geneva. Amnesty International called the use of a firing squad "reprehensible." Mental health experts said it also could traumatize children. The execution is scheduled to be held at the same sprawling military base where Hasan opened fire with a handgun in a medical facility. The Pentagon on Friday declined to say whether families of those killed in Hasan's attack would be invited to attend the execution, as is common practice in US civilian executions. It remains unclear how the Army would select the shooters and what protocols might be followed during the execution itself. The Pentagon said it would release details later. The plan to livestream the execution comes at a time of heightened debate in the US over the death penalty following the [USN:L1N45M04O TEXT:"botched lethal injection"] last week of a Tennessee woman who was sentenced to death for a 1995 murder. The controversy has flared in the run-up to the November 3 US midterm elections in which Republicans are fighting to retain control of Congress.

item.title: Trump dice que Rusia suministrará de inmediato diésel a los mercados de EEUU y el mundo
item.description: El presidente Donald Trump dijo el viernes que Rusia había acordado suministrar de forma inmediata más de 300.000 toneladas de gasóleo al mercado estadounidense y mundial, en un intento por reducir los precios del combustible antes de las elecciones de legislativas de noviembre.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Jarrett Renshaw
item.content:encoded: El presidente Donald Trump dijo el viernes que Rusia había acordado suministrar de forma inmediata más de 300.000 toneladas de gasóleo al mercado estadounidense y mundial, en un intento por reducir los precios del combustible antes de las elecciones de legislativas de noviembre. La medida se anuncia en un momento en que los precios del diésel -que se usa en la agricultura, la calefacción doméstica y el transporte de mercancías- se sitúan cerca de máximos históricos, antes de las elecciones del 3 de noviembre, que determinarán que partido controlará el Congreso. Trump dijo en una publicación en las redes sociales que había tenido una conversación "muy satisfactoria" con el presidente Vladimir Putin, en la que acordaron que Rusia suministraría el gasóleo de forma inmediata. Un enviado de Putin, Kirill Dmitriev, elogió la cooperación entre Rusia y Estados Unidos en materia de diésel y energía en una publicación en X el viernes, poco después de la conversación telefonica. Trump añadio que Rusia suministraría otras 500.000 toneladas en noviembre y otro millón de toneladas "inmediatamente después". Según Trump, llegarían aún más después de eso, "en función del estado de sus refinerías de gasóleo", que han resultado dañadas por los ataques durante la guerra de Rusia contra Ucrania. La inusual medida coincide con la imposición de sanciones estadounidenses a las empresas energéticas rusas por su guerra contra Ucrania, que comenzó en febrero de 2022. El Departamento del Tesoro emitió el viernes una licencia general que permite la importación de diésel ruso hasta el 7 de abril del próximo año. Los precios del gasóleo, que pueden impulsar la inflación, han subido un 70% desde que comenzó este año la guerra de Estados Unidos e Israel contra Irán, a pesar de dos medidas recientes de gran repercusión adoptadas por Trump para impulsar el suministro de este combustible: presionar a los aliados para que liberen reservas de emergencia y ampliar el acceso al diésel teñido de rojo, exento de impuestos, que normalmente se usa para maquinaria agrícola. "La reducción de los precios para los estadounidenses, especialmente para nuestros grandes agricultores, ganaderos y camioneros, es mi máxima prioridad", dijo Trump.

item.title: Trump says Russia to immediately supply 300,000 tons of diesel fuel
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Friday that Russia had agreed to immediately supply over 300,000 tons of diesel fuel to the American and global marketplace after what Trump described as a "highly successful" discussion with Russian President Vladimir Putin.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump said on Friday that Russia had agreed to immediately supply over 300,000 tons of diesel fuel to the American and global marketplace after what Trump described as a "highly successful" discussion with Russian President Vladimir Putin. Trump added that Russia would then deliver 3 million tons of diesel fuel within a short period of time, based on the condition of its diesel refineries, and would immediately supply another 500,000 tons in November and 1 million tons immediately thereafter.

item.title: 欧州市場サマリー（9日）
item.description: ＜ロンドン株式市場＞ 反発して取引を終えた。英長期金利の上昇が一服し、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は週間ベースで０．８６％高だった。...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（9日） 3:46 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞　反発して取引を終えた。英長期金利の上昇が一服し、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は週間ベースで０．８６％高だった。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は前日比１．１３％高、週間では０．０８％上昇した。    トランプ米大統領がイランとの戦闘終結に向け「建設的な」協議を行っているとして、１１月の中間選挙前にイランを攻撃しないと発言。原油相場は売り注文が優勢となる場面があった。    通信大手のボーダフォンは前日比４．９％、エアテル・アフリカは６．３％、ＢＴグループは２．４％いずれも下落。スペースＸが米国の低周波数帯の利用権を取得する契約の締結を発表したことが売り材料視された。    空港や鉄道駅で食品・飲料販売を手掛けるＳＳＰグループは４．１％安。通期営業利益の見通しを引き下げ、売られた。    ＲＢＣキャピタル・マーケッツが投資判断と目標株価を引き上げた半導体部品のモルガン・アドバンスト・マテリアルズは９．４％上昇した。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞　３日ぶりに反発して取引を終えた。長期金利の上昇が一服し、大半の業種で買い注文が優勢だった。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は週間ベースで０．０３％高。    トランプ米大統領が１１月の中間選挙前にイランを攻撃しないと発言。原油価格は一時軟調に推移し、ユーロ圏の長期金利の上昇も一服した。    ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種自動車・部品株指数は前日比１．４６％高。欧州連合（ＥＵ）の通商担当欧州委員は、中国からＥＵへのハイブリッド車（ＨＶ）の輸出半減や、ＥＵの中国市場へのアクセス改善に関して中国と合意したと明らかにした。    通信株指数は２．９３％安。米ＴモバイルＵＳの株式５４％を保有するドイツの通信大手ドイツテレコムは７．９％安。スペースＸが米国の低周波数帯の利用権を取得する契約の締結を発表し、競争激化が警戒された。英通信大手ボーダフォンは４．９％、スペインのテレフォニカは４．６％、フランスの通信オレンジは２．５％それぞれ下落した。    来週からは、上場企業の決算発表シーズンを迎える。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　９月下旬に急拡大していたフランスとイタリアの対独スプレッドが、週間ベースで縮小する見通しとなった。投資家は、財政・政治リスクに対する上乗せ利回りを一段と求める前に、新たな手掛かりを見極めようとしている。    欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の利上げ観測に加え、２０２７年の大統領選挙を控えた政治的不透明感から、フランス国債は売り圧力にさらされている。この日のフランス国債と独国債の利回り格差は１３６ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）。２日には２０１１年１１月以来の高水準となる１５８．６７ｂｐを付けていた。週間ベースでは先週、３４ｂｐ拡大していたが、今週は４．５ｂｐ縮小する見通しとなった。     来年のフランス大統領選の世論調査で首位を走る極右指導者、マリーヌ・ルペン氏は今週、大統領に就任した場合、減税分を差し引いた歳出を３２年までに少なくとも１４００億ユーロ（約２４兆８０００億円）削減すると表明。神経質になっている債券市場に対し、膨張するフランスの債務残高抑制に真剣に取り組む姿勢を示した。    独１０年債利回りは１ｂｐ低下の３．４８％。    独２年債利回りは横ばいの３．０８％。    独伊１０年債利回り格差は１０９ｂｐ。週間では先週２５．５ｂｐ拡大した後、今週は５ｂｐ縮小する見通し。
