item.title: 米軍死刑執行のＴＶ放送可否、国防総省に委ねる＝ＦＣＣ委員長
item.description:
David Shepardson
[ワシントン ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
David Shepardson

[ワシントン ９日 ロイター] - 米連邦通信委員会（ＦＣＣ）のカー委員長は９日、１２月３日に予定される軍の死刑執行を米テレビ局が放送できるかどうかについて、国防総省の判断に委ねると述べた。実現すれば、前例のない放送となる。

米国防総省は８日、２００９年に南部テキサス州のフォートフッド陸軍基地で銃を乱射し１３人を殺害した元陸軍精神科医のニダル・ハサン死刑囚について、１２月３日に予定されている軍による銃殺刑の執行をライブ配信すると明らかにした。

カー氏はＣＮＢＣに対し、地上波テレビでは放送されないと理解していると説明。ただ、放送を認めるかと問われると「最終的には、今後どのように進めるかについて、ヘグセス国防長官の判断に委ねる」と述べた。

ＦＣＣの報道官からコメント要請への回答は現時点で得られていない。ＡＢＣ、ＮＢＣ、ＣＢＳ、ＦＯＸも、死刑執行の放送を検討しているかどうかについて、コメント要請に直ちに回答しなかった。

item.title: Le Panama frappé par un puissant séisme, des dégâts signalés
item.description: Le Panama a été frappé vendredi par un puissant séisme qui a endommagé des habitations sans que des victimes soient signalées dans l'immédiat par les autorités.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le Panama a été frappé vendredi par un puissant séisme qui a endommagé des habitations sans que des victimes soient signalées dans l'immédiat par les autorités. L'institut américain de veille géologique (USGS) a évalué la magnitude à 8,0 sur l'échelle de Richter avant de la rétrograder à 7,7. Il a diffusé une alerte au tsunami pour la côte Pacifique de l'Amérique centrale ainsi que la Colombie et l'Equateur. La secousse, qui s'est produite au large de la côte sud du Panama, a été ressentie dans la capitale de même qu'à San José, la capitale du Costa Rica voisin, selon les correspondants de Reuters. Plusieurs répliques ont été enregistrées par la suite. L'épicentre du séisme était proche de la localité rurale de La Pitaloza, dans la province faiblement peuplée de Herrera, près de l'océan Pacifique. Des dégâts ont été signalés à Chitré, la capitale provinciale de Herrera, et le long de la côte dans la province de Los Santos, a déclaré le chef de l'agence de la protection civile panaméenne, Omar Smith. Des vidéos postées par le journal La Prensa montrent l'effondrement de la tour d'un bâtiment historique et de plusieurs balcons d'un immeuble résidentiel à Penonome, située à mi-chemin entre l'épicentre et Panama, la capitale, où de nombreuses personnes ont évacué précipitamment leurs habitations. Le ministère de l'Education a ordonné la fermeture des écoles dans tout le pays. L'autorité du canal de Panama a déclaré que le canal fonctionnait normalement.

item.title: トランプ氏、メキシコにエネルギー企業間の取引・提携拡大要請＝報道
item.description: [９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[９日 ロイター] - 英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）は９日、トランプ米大統領がメキシコのシェインバウム大統領との電話会談で、両国のエネルギー企業間の取引や提携の拡大を強く求めたと報じた。

同紙が関係筋の話として報じたところによると、両首脳は、昨年米国が韓国と結んだ協定と同様の取り決めについて協議した。この協定で、韓国政府は１０００億ドル相当の米国産エネルギー製品を購入し、さらに米国内に数十億ドル規模の追加投資を行うことで合意していた。

ある米政府当局者はＦＴに対し、協議はメキシコの対米貿易黒字の削減に焦点が当てられたと説明。その上で、両首脳はメキシコが既に需要の約４分の３を依存している米国産天然ガスの購入拡大の可能性についても協議したと明らかにした。

item.title: Fuerte terremoto sacude Panamá, sin registros de destrucción masiva
item.description: Un terremoto de magnitud 7.7 sacudió el sur de Panamá el viernes, causando daños en edificios y dejando a miles de personas asustadas en las calles, pero el país aparentemente evitó una destrucción generalizada o víctimas mortales.
item.dc:creator: Elida Moreno, Dave Sherwood
item.content:encoded: Un terremoto de magnitud 7.7 sacudió el sur de Panamá el viernes, causando daños en edificios y dejando a miles de personas asustadas en las calles, pero el país aparentemente evitó una destrucción generalizada o víctimas mortales. El Servicio Geológico de Estados Unidos (USGS, por su sigla en inglés) informó que el epicentro se ubicó en una zona poco poblada a unos 200 kilómetros (km) de la capital y a una profundidad de 12.6 km. En las horas siguientes, a pesar de que decenas de réplicas sacudieron el istmo, el Canal de Panamá informó que operaba con normalidad y el Aeropuerto Internacional de Tocumen levantó la suspensión de vuelos. Los oficinistas del exclusivo centro de negocios de Ciudad de Panamá -una urbe de unas 410,000 personas- se preocupaban por cómo regresar a casa en medio del caos vehicular, después de que el terremoto empujo a miles a las calles en busca de resguardo. Juan Sánchez, un empleado del Ministerio de Economía de 37 años, esperaba un autobús que, según dijo, dudaba que llegara. "Evacuaron todos estos edificios. Todos están afuera. Ahora el problema es, ¿cómo volvemos a casa?", se preguntó. El presidente Raúl Mulino viajó a Penonomé, una ciudad ubicada a medio camino entre el epicentro y Ciudad de Panamá, donde algunos edificios se derrumbaron y una iglesia resultó dañada. A pesar de la fuerza del movimiento telúrico del viernes, el país parece haberse librado de la destrucción causada por otros sismos recientes y potentes en la región. Por el momento, no se reportaron muertos ni heridos. En junio, [USN:L6N42Y0SA TEXT:"dos potentes sismos"] consecutivos en Venezuela causaron la muerte de más de 6,500 personas, mientras que un terremoto en [USN:L1N4480IR TEXT:"Colombia"] en agosto dejó más de 300 fallecidos. Un informe del USGS estimó que alrededor de 43,000 panameños vivían en áreas con al menos una exposición severa al terremoto. Esto se compara con casi 1.4 millones en el área de los dos sismos en Venezuela y más de 1.6 millones en la zona afectada por el terremoto en el oeste de Colombia. VIBRACIONES PROLONGADAS Néstor Luque, director del Instituto de Geociencias de Panamá, atribuyó el sismo al sistema de fallas Azuero-Soná que, según explicó, contiene una enorme acumulación de presión que se libera ocasionalmente. "Las señales sísmicas se propagaron por todo el territorio nacional, por eso se sintió en todas partes", dijo. En Ciudad de Panamá, Luque dijo haber contado 40 segundos de vibraciones, aunque en otras zonas es posible que se hayan sentido temblores aún más prolongados. Sabina Ríos, quien se encontraba en el sexto piso de un antiguo edificio militar estadounidense en Ciudad de Panamá, dijo que el temblor fue inusualmente fuerte y prolongado. "El sismo se sintió fuerte y duró mucho tiempo, el más largo que he sentido en años", dijo Ríos. Víctor Pinzón, un trabajador de mantenimiento de 48 años, dijo a Reuters que había visto a los limpiadores de ventanas de rascacielos soportar el temblor. "Es un milagro que no hayan muerto", dijo. "Parecía que estaban meciéndose en una hamaca", agregó. Los terremotos fuertes no son comunes en Panamá, y algunos ancianos lloraban mientras evacuaban a las calles. "Estamos asustados, solos los dos aquí, la casa se nos rajó y tememos que se nos caiga encima", dijo Ricardo Brown, de 74 años, en una conversación telefónica desde la zona Las Minas, en la provincia de Herrera, al sur de Panamá, donde el sismo dañó varias viviendas. Omar Smith, director de la agencia de protección civil de Panamá, declaró al medio Telemetro que también se habían reportado impactos en Chitré, la capital de Herrera, y en la costa de la provincia de Los Santos.

item.title: Forte terremoto atinge Panamá, mas não causa grandes destruições
item.description: Um terremoto de magnitude 7,7 atingiu o sul do Panamá nesta sexta-feira, causando danos a edifícios e levando milhares de pessoas às ruas, mas o país parece ter escapado de uma destruição generalizada ou de vítimas fatais.
item.dc:creator: Elida Moreno, Dave Sherwood
item.content:encoded: Um terremoto de magnitude 7,7 atingiu o sul do Panamá nesta sexta-feira, causando danos a edifícios e levando milhares de pessoas às ruas, mas o país parece ter escapado de uma destruição generalizada ou de vítimas fatais. O Serviço Geológico dos Estados Unidos informou que o terremoto ocorreu a uma profundidade de 12,6 km, com epicentro em uma área pouco povoada a cerca de 200 km da capital, e que havia possibilidade de algumas vítimas. Nas horas seguintes, mesmo com mais de 40 réplicas abalando o país do istmo, o Canal do Panamá e a mina de cobre Cobre Panamá informaram que as operações estavam normais, e o Aeroporto Internacional de Tocumen revogou a suspensão dos voos. Funcionários de escritórios no sofisticado centro financeiro do centro da Cidade do Panamá se preocupavam em como chegar em casa no meio do engarrafamento, depois que o terremoto levou milhares de pessoas às ruas. Juan Sánchez, um funcionário de 37 anos do Ministério da Economia, esperava por um ônibus que, segundo ele, duvidava que chegaria. “Eles evacuaram todos esses prédios. Todo mundo está na rua. Agora o problema é: como vamos chegar em casa?” O presidente Raúl Mulino viajou para Penonomé, uma cidade localizada a meio caminho entre o epicentro e a Cidade do Panamá, onde alguns prédios desabaram e uma igreja foi danificada. Apesar da intensidade do tremor desta sexta-feira, o país parece ter sido poupado da destruição causada por outros fortes terremotos recentes na região, sem que tenham sido relatadas mortes ou feridos imediatamente. Tremores consecutivos na Venezuela, em junho, mataram vários milhares de pessoas, enquanto um terremoto na Colômbia, em agosto, matou mais de 300. Um relatório de exposição elaborado pelo USGS estimou que cerca de 43 mil panamenhos viviam em áreas com exposição pelo menos grave ao terremoto. Isso se compara a quase 1,4 milhão na área dos terremotos gêmeos na Venezuela e a mais de 1,6 milhão na zona atingida pelo terremoto no oeste da Colômbia. VIBRAÇÕES PROLONGADAS Nestor Luque, diretor do instituto de geociências do Panamá, disse que o terremoto foi desencadeado pelo Sistema de Falhas de Azuero-Sona, que há muito tempo acumulava pressão. “É um sistema de falhas ativas que, ocasionalmente, devido ao acúmulo de tensão, libera essa quantidade de energia”, disse ele. “Os sinais sísmicos se propagaram por todo o território nacional e é por isso que puderam ser sentidos em todos os lugares.” Na Cidade do Panamá, Luque disse ter contado 40 segundos de vibrações, embora outras áreas possam ter sentido tremores ainda mais longos. Sabina Ríos, que estava no sexto andar de um antigo prédio da época da ocupação militar dos EUA na Cidade do Panamá, disse que o tremor foi excepcionalmente forte e prolongado. “O terremoto foi forte e durou muito tempo, o mais longo que senti em anos”, disse Ríos. Víctor Pinzón, um funcionário de manutenção de 48 anos, contou à Reuters que viu limpadores de janelas de arranha-céus resistindo ao tremor. “É um milagre que eles não tenham morrido”, disse ele. “Parecia que estavam balançando em uma rede.” Terremotos fortes não são comuns no Panamá, e alguns moradores idosos choravam enquanto evacuavam para as ruas. “Estamos com medo. Somos só nós dois, idosos, aqui. A casa rachou e temos medo de que ela desabe sobre nós”, disse Ricardo Brown, de 74 anos, na província de Herrera, no sul do Panamá, onde afirmou ter visto várias casas danificadas. Omar Smith, que chefia a agência de proteção civil do Panamá, disse ao veículo de notícias Telemetro Reporta que também foram relatados tremores em Chitre, capital de Herrera, e ao longo da costa na província de Los Santos. O USGS estimou que as perdas econômicas poderiam chegar de 1% a 10% do Produto Interno Bruto do Panamá, e a concessionária de energia Naturgy relatou cortes de energia em seis províncias. O Panamá tinha programado um exercício nacional de retirada para a segunda-feira da próxima semana, a fim de testar as capacidades de resposta a emergências do país em caso de terremotos.

item.title: Trump selects Katie Zacharia as White House press secretary
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Friday that he has appointed Katie Zacharia, a communications adviser for his Truth Social platform, to serve as White House press secretary following Karoline Leavitt's departure in August.
item.dc:creator: Jasper Ward
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump said on Friday that he has appointed Katie Zacharia, a communications adviser for his Truth Social platform, to serve as White House press secretary following Karoline Leavitt's [USN:FWN4491F6 TEXT:"departure"] in August. He said Zacharia has an "unblemished record of support, and has been a loyal and brilliant supporter." "I am confident that Katie will deliver strong results for our Country as the next White House Press Secretary, as she has the respect of, and will work fantastically with, the Media, the American People, and my Administration," Trump wrote on Truth Social. The New York Times first reported the news of her appointment. The selection will put Zacharia at the center of the White House's public messaging operation in the final stretch before next month's midterm elections , when Trump's agenda and his party's control of Congress will be put before voters. Zacharia said in a social media post that she welcomed the appointment and looks forward to "working with the White House press corps, and with reporters across the country" to get Trump's message out. Trump's approval rating fell to 32% — the lowest of his political career — as his fellow Republicans soured on his handling of the cost of living and the Iran war , a recent [USN:L6N45D0NV TEXT:"Reuters/Ipsos"] poll found. The selection of Zacharia underscores the close ties between Trump's administration and his broader political and media operation. It comes after Trump Media unveiled in July that for a fee it would give banks and trading firms "the fastest" [USN:L4N43I1AE TEXT:"access to posts"] from influential Truth Social accounts, such as the president's, whose posts often move global markets. Zacharia has worked as a senior communications adviser for Truth Social, the Republican president's social media platform, and the Trump Media & Technology Group (DJT.O) since June, according to her LinkedIn page. She briefly served as a spokesperson for the Department of Homeland Security before departing in March. Zacharia, an attorney who frequently appears on conservative outlets Fox News and Newsmax, previously worked as a legal adviser for Fix California, a conservative group that aims to address what it described as "the left's stranglehold" on state politics. The group was founded by Richard Grenell, who has served as Trump's envoy to Venezuela and the interim president and executive director of the Kennedy Center in Washington. Zacharia interned at the White House during President George W. Bush's administration.

item.title: Strong Panama quake shakes nation, but avoids major destruction
item.description: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck southern Panama on Friday, damaging buildings and sending thousands into the streets, but the country appeared to escape widespread destruction or deaths.
item.dc:creator: Elida Moreno, Dave Sherwood
item.content:encoded: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck southern Panama on Friday, damaging buildings and sending thousands into the streets, but the country appeared to escape widespread destruction or deaths. The US Geological Survey said the earthquake hit at a depth of 12.6 km (7.8 miles), with an epicenter in a sparsely populated area about 200 km (124 miles) from the capital, and that some casualties were possible. In the following hours, even as more than 40 aftershocks rattled the isthmus nation, the Panama Canal and Cobre Panama copper mine reported normal operations and the Tocumen International Airport lifted a suspension on flights. Office workers in the upscale business hub of downtown Panama City fretted about how to get home in the snarl of traffic, after the quake sent thousands into the streets. Juan Sanchez, a 37-year-old economy ministry employee, waited for a bus he said he doubted would arrive. "They evacuated all of these buildings. Everyone is outside. Now the problem is, how do we get home?" President Raul Mulino traveled to Penonome, a city about halfway between the epicenter and Panama City, where some buildings collapsed and a church was damaged. Despite the force of Friday's tremor, the country appeared to have been spared the [USN:L6N44903E TEXT:"destruction"] of other recent powerful quakes in the [USN:L6N42X19G TEXT:"region"], with no deaths or injuries immediately reported. Back-to-back quakes in Venezuela in June killed several thousand people, while a quake in Colombia in August killed more than 300. An exposure report by the USGS estimated about 43,000 Panamanians lived in areas with at least severe exposure to the quake. This compares to nearly 1.4 million in the area of the twin quakes in Venezuela and over 1.6 million in the quake-hit zone of western Colombia. PROLONGED VIBRATIONS Nestor Luque, director of Panama's geosciences institute, attributed the quake to the Azuero Sona Fault System that he said contained a massive buildup of pressure that is occasionally released. "The seismic signals have traveled throughout the national territory and that is why it could be felt everywhere." In Panama City, Luque said he counted 40 seconds of vibrations, though other areas may have felt even longer tremors. Sabina Rios, who was on the sixth floor of an old US military-era building in Panama City, said the shaking was unusually strong and prolonged. "The quake felt strong and lasted a long time, the longest I’ve felt in years,” Rios said. Victor Pinzon, a 48-year-old maintenance worker, told Reuters he had watched high-rise window cleaners ride out the shaking. “It’s a miracle they didn’t get killed,” he said. “They looked like they were swinging in a hammock.” Strong earthquakes are not common in Panama, and some elderly residents were in tears as they evacuated into the streets. “We’re scared. It’s just the two of us old folks here. The house has cracked, and we’re afraid it could fall on us,” said Ricardo Brown, 74, in Herrera province in southern Panama, where he said he saw a number of damaged homes. Omar Smith, who heads Panama's civil protection agency, told news outlet Telemetro Reporta that impacts had also been reported in Chitre, the capital of Herrera, and along the coast in Los Santos province. The USGS estimated economic losses could amount to 1% to 10% of Panama's gross domestic product, and electricity provider Naturgy reported power outages in six provinces. Panama was due to hold a national evacuation drill on Monday of next week to test the country's emergency response.

item.title: US judge rules Justice Department use of voter rolls unlawful
item.description: A US judge ruled on Friday that the Justice Department's push to obtain state voter rolls and check them against a federal immigration database to demand that states remove voters it deemed ineligible was unlawful.
item.dc:creator: Luc Cohen
item.content:encoded: A US judge ruled on Friday that the Justice Department's push to obtain [USN:L6N41312P TEXT:"state voter rolls"] and check them against a federal immigration database to demand that states remove voters it deemed ineligible was unlawful. US District Judge Sparkle Sooknanan's decision marked the latest setback for President Donald Trump 's push to expand federal control over election administration ahead of the November 3 midterms , with his Republican Party battling to hold majorities in both houses of Congress. In a 78-page decision siding with a challenge to the Justice Department's practice brought by watchdog group Common Cause, Sooknanan wrote that the Justice Department had downplayed the risk that its practice would wrongfully disenfranchise eligible US citizens despite evidence that the immigration database, known as SAVE, could be inaccurate. "The challenged policy represents the federal government's attempt to decide who gets to vote. But Congress has left that authority where our Constitution has always placed it: with the states," wrote Sooknanan, who is based in Washington and was appointed by Democratic President Joe Biden. SUPREME COURT PAUSED PREVIOUS RULING Ming Cheung, a lawyer with the American Civil Liberties Union who represented the plaintiffs, said in a statement, "Today's ruling makes clear that the administration cannot use the federal government to disrupt elections." The Justice Department is reviewing the decision, a spokesperson said. In a separate case, Sooknanan [USN:S0N3R9073 TEXT:"blocked"] the Trump administration in June from using an expanded version of the SAVE database to check the accuracy of voter rolls. The US Supreme Court [USN:S0N42U04A TEXT:"temporarily paused"] that decision last month. Federal election law prohibits the systematic review of voter rolls in the 90 days before any federal election, potentially blunting the impact of both Sooknanan's decision and the Supreme Court's pause of her previous order on the upcoming midterms. LATEST DEFEAT FOR JUSTICE DEPARTMENT Trump, who falsely claims his loss in the 2020 presidential election was due to voter fraud, ordered the Justice Department last year to crack down on voting by ineligible people, despite multiple state audits and independent studies showing such voter fraud is rare. The Justice Department then demanded that nearly all 50 states hand over their complete, unredacted voter rolls, including sensitive information such as voters' Social Security numbers or dates of birth. Eighteen mostly Republican-led states complied. After receiving the voter data, the Justice Department ran it through SAVE and alerted states to voters found to be non-citizens so the states could remove them. Sooknanan said the Trump administration's expansion of SAVE meant it now contained citizenship data from the Social Security Administration, which could be outdated, meaning many immigrants who had since been naturalized as US citizens would still be flagged as non-citizens. The Justice Department [USN:L6N44118V TEXT:"sued"] 30 Democratic-led and Republican states that refused to hand over their unredacted voter rolls, as well as Washington, DC. It has lost 26 of those cases so far, without winning one.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro descarta privatização da Petrobras como "boataria"
item.description: O senador Flávio Bolsonaro, candidato do PL à Presidência, negou nesta sexta-feira rumores de que, se for eleito, tentará privatizar a Petrobras e outras empresas estatais.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O senador Flávio Bolsonaro, candidato do PL à Presidência, negou nesta sexta-feira rumores de que, se for eleito, tentará privatizar a Petrobras (PETR3.SA) e outras empresas estatais. Segundo ele, existe uma onda de boatos contra a sua candidatura para tentar reverter a liderança que teve no primeiro turno da eleição presidencial. “Isso é uma boataria, é uma boataria atrás da outra”, disse Flávio a jornalistas na entrada de um encontro com apoiadores e empresários na zona sudoeste do Rio de Janeiro. Flávio Bolsonaro venceu o primeiro turno da eleição presidencial com 47,03% dos votos válidos, contra 45,16% do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), que tenta a reeleição. As primeiras pesquisas após a votação de domingo mostram que o senador continua à frente do petista antes do segundo turno, marcado para o dia 25 deste mês. Ao ser questionado se pretendia mudar o comando da estatal, caso seja eleito, o candidato do PL disse que primeiro é preciso mudar o presidente da República. Durante o governo de seu pai, Jair Bolsonaro, vários ativos e bens da empresa, como refinarias, foram vendidos, num movimento visto por alguns como uma tentativa de esvaziar e enfraquecer a companhia para viabilizar uma futura venda. Flávio Bolsonaro acusou ainda o atual governo de estar preparando uma bomba para os consumidores brasileiros com programas de subsídio, subvenção e desoneração de combustíveis. Nesta sexta-feira, o [USN:L1N45V0MB TEXT:"governo anunciou"] a ampliação dessas medidas para diesel, gasolina e etanol por 30 dias. O governo alega que essas iniciativas são necessárias para minimizar os impactos da guerra no Oriente Médio que afeta petróleo e derivados. "O atual governo, muita gente não percebeu ainda, qual é a outra bomba que ele vai jogar no consumidor, quem usa moto, carros e caminhoneiros. O Lula pela Petrobras deu um subsídio de 2 reais no preço do diesel. Ele acaba no dia seguinte à eleição. É isso que esse governo irresponsável está fazendo“, disse Flávio. Em entrevista coletiva em Brasília para anunciar a prorrogação, o ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, negou que ela tenha relação com o período eleitoral e disse que os preços internacionais do petróleo seguem pressionados por causa da guerra no Oriente Médio. No início da tarde desta sexta, os preços do petróleo Brent LCOc1 operavam próximos a US$104, muito acima dos níveis ao redor de US$70 observados antes do início da guerra.

item.title: 欧州主要企業7─9月期、21％増益予想 エネルギーが好調＝ＬＳＥＧ
item.description: [９日 ロイター] - ＬＳＥＧのＩＢＥＳが集計した８日のデータによると、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数構成企業全体の２０...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州主要企業7─9月期、21％増益予想　エネルギーが好調＝ＬＳＥＧ 2:45 配信

2024年2月27日、ドイツ・フランクフルトで撮影。 REUTERS/Kai Pfaffenbach

[９日 ロイター] - ＬＳＥＧのＩＢＥＳが集計した８日のデータによると、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数構成企業全体の２０２６年７─９月期の利益は、前年同期比２１％増と見込まれる。欧米で長期金利が高水準で推移し、市場環境が厳しさを見せる中、エネルギーや資源関連の企業が全体を押し上げる見通しだ。

２６年４─６月期の２３．９％増を下回るものの、四半期利益の伸び率としては、過去４年間で２番目の高さとなる見込み。エネルギー企業は約２．２倍と伸びが高水準で、これを除くと９．７％増となる。不動産企業は７１．５％の減益になると見通した。

全体の売上高も１０．６％増と、好調に推移しているとみられる。

ドイツ銀行は今週初めのリポートで「需要は堅調で、企業はコスト増を価格に転嫁でき、売上高の増加につながっている。燃料高に伴うコスト増加の影響は、強調されているほどは大きくはない」と指摘した。

来週は、オランダの半導体製造装置メーカーＡＳＭＬホールディングやスウェーデン通信機器大手エリクソンなどが決算発表を予定している。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：米株高・金利上昇は併存可能、タームプレミアムの行方に不安も アングル：ＡＩ企業、臨床試験の成否をシミュレーションで予測 アングル：米政府、借り入れコスト抑制へ選択肢狭まる　歳出削減以外ならインフレ加速も アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず 最終更新: 10/10(土) 2:45 ロイター

item.title: 中国とＥＵ、電動車輸出巡り議論深化 北京で閣僚級協議
item.description:
Joe Cash
[北京 ９日 ロイター] - 中国商務省は９日、王文濤商務相と欧州連合（ＥＵ）のシェフチョビッチ欧州...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国とＥＵ、電動車輸出巡り議論深化　北京で閣僚級協議 2:43 配信

2024年10月24日、ベルギーのゼーブルッヘ港 REUTERS/Yves Herman

Joe Cash

[北京 ９日 ロイター] - 中国商務省は９日、王文濤商務相と欧州連合（ＥＵ）のシェフチョビッチ欧州委員（通商担当）による北京での２日間の協議が「実務的かつ建設的」なものだったと明らかにした。ハイブリッド車（ＨＶ）の貿易を巡り、世界貿易機関（ＷＴＯ）のルールに整合する形での「理解」に達したと発表した。ＥＵ側は中国による車の輸出急増を懸念し、協議の主要テーマに位置付けていた。

中国とＥＵは、中国の電気自動車（ＥＶ）を巡るＥＵの調査関連の審査手続きや、価格に関する事項について、協議を継続することでも一致。ＷＴＯ規則の枠組み内で特定の品目に対する関税引き下げを引き続き検討するほか、医療機器の市場アクセスに関する対話を続けることも明らかにした。

ＥＵの対中貿易赤字は、１日当たり１０億ユーロ（約１１億２０００万ドル）超に達している。シェフチョビッチ氏は今回の中国訪問で「具体的な成果」を求めると述べていた。

中国とＥＵは安価な中国製ＥＶの輸出を巡って２４年から対立。２０２５年１０月─２６年９月までの１年間で、ＥＵのプラグインハイブリッド車（ＰＨＥＶ）の輸入は８６％増え、価格は２０％下落した。２５年のＰＨＥＶ輸入額に占める中国のシェアは約３割だったが、現在、輸入の半数以上が中国製となっている。双方の対立は、ブランデーや乳製品、重要鉱物などの分野にも拡大している。

中国商務省によると、３回目となる定例協議は２７年３月に開催。来年１月には閣僚級のテレビ会合も開く予定だとしている。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：欧州国債、財政懸念で選別進む　フランスは売り・ドイツに資金逃避 コラム：ＥＵのＥＶ補助金巡る対中調査、自らに跳ね返るリスクも コラム：短距離フライト削減でＣＯ2対策なるか、的外れの欧州 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 焦点：コーヒー企業「アフリカ離れ」も、ＥＵが森林破壊防止法 最終更新: 10/10(土) 2:43 ロイター

item.title: Holland & Knight, other firms disclose data security breaches
item.description: Two more large US law firms, Holland & Knight and Squire Patton Boggs, have disclosed data security breaches to state regulators, and a third was hit with a new proposed class action in federal court over a reported hack.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: Two more large US law firms, Holland & Knight and Squire Patton Boggs, have disclosed data security breaches to state regulators, and a third was hit with a new proposed class action in federal court over a reported hack. Holland & Knight, which employs 2,200 lawyers, and the 2,600-attorney Squire Patton Boggs both told Vermont’s state attorney general on Thursday that Social Security numbers were exposed in the incidents that affected the firms. Holland & Knight in a statement said "a threat actor used social engineering techniques to gain unauthorized remote access to a firm computer." It said it "identified the small number of files involved and promptly notified the clients whose information was contained in those files." Squire Patton Boggs in a statement said its incident involved "an unauthorized third party obtaining a limited set of information from the firm." Both firms said there was no disruption to their client services. Separately, law firm Nelson Mullins was sued on Wednesday in federal court in South Carolina for allegedly failing to safeguard private information following a breach at the firm. In a statement, the firm said a cyber group that targets law firms “accessed the laptop of a single user and copied a limited number of documents accessible by this user.” The firm, which employs more than 1,000 lawyers, said the incident “was contained and did not involve any other systems, devices, or accounts.” Nelson Mullins said it was in contact with law enforcement authorities and supporting their investigation. The latest disclosures underscore cybersecurity risks for law firms, which routinely hold sensitive client communications, financial records and personal data that can be valuable to hackers. Recent breaches at major law firms have highlighted how cybercriminals are increasingly targeting the legal industry through tactics including so-called social-engineering schemes designed to gain access to confidential information. Several law firms including WilmerHale and Weil Gotshal have paid a ransom or suppression payment following a data breach. WilmerHale is also facing a lawsuit in DC federal court over its alleged breach. Read more: [USN:L6N45U099 TEXT:"Law firm Sheppard Mullin sued in class action after data breach disclosure"] [USN:L6N45F0WX TEXT:"Law firm Seyfarth says breach exposed client documents"] [USN:L6N45D0TP TEXT:"Law firm Greenberg Traurig faces class actions after cyber breach"] [USN:L6N44V17V TEXT:"Data at law firms Quinn Emanuel, McDermott exposed in cyber breaches"] [USN:L6N43H0AM TEXT:"Law firm WilmerHale sued in class action after data breach"]

item.title: Ecobank to Join China’s CIPS Payments Platform for Yuan Settlement
item.description: By Duncan Miriri African lender Ecobank will sign an agreement to join the China Interbank Payments System for yuan transactions, its chief executive said, as banks race to capitalize on growing trade and investment ties between China and Africa. Demand for direct settlement of local …
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
By Duncan Miriri

African lender Ecobank will sign an agreement to join the China Interbank Payments System for yuan transactions, its chief executive said, as banks race to capitalize on growing trade and investment ties between China and Africa.

Demand for direct settlement of local currencies into yuan has been rising across the continent as commerce with China expands and Beijing pushes to internationalize its currency, prompting banks to invest in the necessary payments infrastructure.

“CIPS is an important part of the infrastructure supporting international RMB payments,” Jeremy Awori told Reuters ahead of signing the deal in China on Saturday.

CIPS connects more than 5,000 banks in over 100 countries and territories, Awori said, providing businesses trading with China with more direct settlement options.

“This cooperation really strengthens the link between the Chinese RMB payment infrastructure and our African banking platform and payment infrastructure, which is obviously critical,” he said.

Ecobank, which operates in 34 African countries, is also in talks with Bank of China to jointly offer yuan settlement services and expects to make an announcement soon, Awori said.

The initiative would complement Ecobank’s CIPS participation and other payments partnerships aimed at facilitating trade between Africa and China.

While the dollar remains dominant in global trade and foreign exchange reserves, growing commercial ties with China have encouraged some African governments, companies and banks to increase their use of the yuan.

South Africa’s Standard Bank, which became the first African lender to connect to CIPS last November, secured authorization last month with Industrial and Commercial Bank of China to clear yuan transactions across the continent.

China-Africa trade rose nearly 18% last year, according to Chinese customs data, and Beijing removed tariffs on imports from 53 African nations on May 1.

Rwanda’s Bank of Kigali has become the latest African bank to join CIPS , while Banco de Fomento Angola (BFA) is also planning to join the platform.

item.title: Precios de bonos del Tesoro de EEUU caen mientras inversores esperan datos de inflación
item.description: Los precios de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos cayeron el viernes, revirtiendo parte de las ganancias de inicios de semana, mientras el valor del petróleo se mantenía alto y los inversores aguardaban los próximos informes de inflación en busca de pistas sobre las medidas que tomará la Reserva Federal.
item.dc:creator: Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
item.content:encoded: Los precios de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos cayeron el viernes, revirtiendo parte de las ganancias de inicios de semana, mientras el valor del petróleo se mantenía alto y los inversores aguardaban los próximos informes de inflación en busca de pistas sobre las medidas que tomará la Reserva Federal. El rendimiento de referencia a 10 años avanzó 2,8 puntos básicos, al 5,261%, tras alcanzar esta semana un máximo en 24 años. Sin embargo, en la semana, los rendimientos a 10 años bajaron un 3,5 puntos básicos, su mayor descenso semanal en dos meses. El retorno a 30 años subió levemente, al 5,608%, pero cayó 2,9 puntos básicos en términos semanales. Cuando los precios de los bonos del Tesoro caen, los rendimientos suben. En el extremo más corto de la curva, la rentabilidad a dos años , que suele reflejar las expectativas sobre las tasas de interés, subió 4,4 puntos básicos, al 4,799%. La curva de rendimientos se aplanaba por segundo día consecutivo el viernes, y el diferencial entre los rendimientos a dos y 10 años se redujo de 46,7 a 45,5 puntos básicos. Los agentes en el mercado tienen la mirada puesta en los datos de inflación de la próxima semana. Los próximos informes del Índice de Precios al Consumidor y del Índice de Precios al Productor se publicarán el miércoles y el jueves, respectivamente. Ruchir Sharma, economista de Nomura, escribió en una nota de investigación que es probable que la inflación subyacente del IPC se haya desacelerado en septiembre a medida que se desvaneció el impulso temporal a los precios de las telecomunicaciones inalámbricas. "Teniendo en cuenta la poca urgencia de realizar aumentos de tasas consecutivas, así como la proximidad de las elecciones de mitad de mandato, es improbable que nuestro pronóstico de inflación aumente la probabilidad de un alza de tasas por parte de la Reserva Federal en octubre", dijo Sharma.

item.title: トランプ氏、ロシアがディーゼル供給で合意 30万トン超即時供給へ
item.description: [ワシントン／モスクワ ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン／モスクワ ９日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は９日、ロシアのプーチン大統領との「極めて成功した」協議の結果、ロシアが米国と世界市場向けにディーゼル（軽油）３０万トン超を直ちに供給することで合意したと述べた。

トランプ氏によると、ロシアは製油所の稼働状況に応じ、その後に短期間のうちに合計３００万トンのディーゼル燃料を供給。１１月に５０万トンを直ちに供給し、その後さらに１００万トンを速やかに供給するという。

これに先立ちトランプ氏は、ホワイトハウスでのイベントで「ディーゼルに関して間もなく大きな発表がある」とし、「われわれはこの問題を徹底的に解決するつもりだ」と述べていた。

プーチン大統領のドミトリエフ特使もＸへの投稿で、プーチン大統領がトランプ大統領と行った電話会談でディーゼル供給に関し合意したとし、「ディーゼルとエネルギーに関するロシアと米国の協力は世界に利益をもたらすだろう」と述べた。

これに関連して複数の業界関係筋は、トランプ氏は一部の省庁トップに対し、ディーゼル価格の抑制策を検討するよう近く指示を出す可能性があるとの見方を示していた。トランプ氏は大統領覚書などの形で、エネルギー生産を妨げている州・地方レベルの規制を回避する方策の検討を関係当局に求めるほか、冷戦時代に制定された国防生産法（ＤＰＡ）を活用して原油や燃料の生産拡大を促す可能性があるとしていた。

米国とイスラエルによるイランへの攻撃が始まって以来、ディーゼル価格は約７０％急騰し、１１月３日の米中間選挙まで約１カ月となる中、米国のディーゼル価格は過去最高値近辺を推移している。

item.title: トランプ氏、死刑ライブ配信は未決定 米軍基地の銃乱射事件
item.description:
Bo Erickson Gram Slattery
[ワシントン ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Bo Erickson　Gram Slattery

[ワシントン　９日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は９日、２００９年に南部テキサス州のフォートフッド陸軍基地で１３人を殺害した元陸軍精神科医のニダル・ハサン死刑囚の銃殺刑の執行について、死刑執行を承認するとしつつも、ライブ配信については決定していないと述べた。

バンス副大統領も、ライブ配信計画については実施されるかどうか分からないとの認識を示した。

米国防総省は８日、１２月３日に予定されている軍による銃殺刑の執行をライブ配信すると明らかにし、宗教指導者や共和党議員らから批判を招いていた。

バンス氏はシンシナティで記者団に、ライブ配信について「実際に行われるかどうかは分からない」と述べ、配信されても「私は見ない」と言明した。

事情に詳しいホワイトハウス高官は、トランプ氏はライブ配信の「考えに反対していない」が、立場はまだ固まっておらず、考えを変える可能性があると述べた。同高官によると、ホワイトハウスには議員や政権の支持者、宗教指導者らから懸念が寄せられ、ライブ配信を見送るよう求められている。

バンス氏は、「死刑執行の方法を巡ってどのような論争があろうと、ハサン死刑囚が多くの罪のない人々を残忍に殺害したことを忘れないでほしい」とも述べた。

トランプ氏はホワイトハウスで９日に開かれたイベントで、ハサン死刑囚が銃殺刑に処されると述べたものの、ヘグセス国防長官が８日に発表した（死刑執行を中継する）計画についてはコメントしなかった。

ホワイトハウスは、関連する全ての質問を国防総省に委ねている。

今回の決定を巡っては、一部の共和党議員からも批判の声が上がっている。共和党のトム・ティリス上院議員（ノースカロライナ州選出）は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）への投稿で、この計画を「嫌悪感を超えるものだ」と非難。「公開処刑はイランやアフガニスタンのような抑圧的な独裁政権が行うことだ」とし、「米国でそんなことがあってはならない」と述べた。

item.title: Mike Ditka, Hall of Fame player and Bears coach, dies at 86
item.description: Mike Ditka, a Pro Football Hall of Fame tight end best known as the slick-haired and mustachioed head coach who led the NFL's Chicago Bears to their only Super Bowl triumph in 1986, has died. He was 86.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mike Ditka, a Pro Football Hall of Fame tight end best known as the slick-haired and mustachioed head coach who led the NFL's Chicago Bears to their only Super Bowl triumph in 1986, has died. He was 86. Ditka's death was announced in a statement by his family on Friday. No cause of death was given. "It is with profound sadness that we announce the passing of our beloved husband, father, grandfather, and friend," Ditka's family said in a statement. "While the world knew Mike as a Hall of Fame football player, legendary coach, and leader of the Chicago Bears’ Super Bowl XX championship team, we knew him as the heart of our family. "Mike will be missed beyond measure and remembered forever." Revered in Chicago and famous nationwide as "Da Coach," Ditka was a blunt, straight-talking legend with a devoted following and restaurants bearing his name. He also sold a number of products with his name on, including cigars, sausages and wine. TRANSFORMED THE TIGHT END POSITION As a player, Ditka revolutionized the tight end position and was a five-time Pro Bowl selection while playing with the Bears from 1961-66 before moving on to the Philadelphia Eagles and then the Dallas Cowboys, where he featured in the team's Super Bowl triumph in January 1972. Selected fifth overall by the Bears in the 1961 NFL Draft, Ditka introduced a new dimension to the tight end position that once was viewed primarily as an assignment for a tough, talented blocker. While Ditka, also affectionately known as "Iron Mike," was a superior blocker, he became one of the first tight ends to catch a large number of passes. He earned Rookie of the Year honors after becoming the first tight end in NFL history to record 1,000 receiving yards in a season and went on to win the 1963 NFL championship with Chicago prior to the start of the Super Bowl era. At the time of his retirement after the 1972 season, Ditka ranked second among all tight ends in receptions, according to the Pro Football Hall of Fame. He is also the only individual in the NFL's modern era to win a league title with the same team as a player and head coach. "Mike's impact on the Chicago Bears organization, over decades as a player, coach and proud icon and ambassador for our organization is immeasurable," the team said in a statement. "His integral role in bringing world championships to our city and our franchise, both as a player and as our coach, established prominence and excellence at a world-class level, but also created a lifetime of cherished memories in the hearts and minds of Bears fans that will last for generations." DITKA 'EPITOMIZED FOOTBALL' Following his playing career Ditka became a member of Tom Landry's coaching staff in Dallas where he won a Super Bowl. He eventually returned to Chicago as head coach and turned the Bears into one of the league's most dominant champions. The Bears team that Ditka led to Super Bowl glory featured one of the most vaunted defenses in NFL history and a top-ranked offense. With the likes of Walter Payton, William "The Refrigerator" Perry, Jim McMahon and Mike Singletary, the Bears transcended professional sports and became a global pop culture phenomenon after recording “The Super Bowl Shuffle” rap song and accompanying music video that became an unlikely hit. The song was released weeks before the Bears beat the New England Patriots 46-10 in the Super Bowl. At the time, it was the largest margin of victory in any Super Bowl. After the game, the Chicago players carried Ditka, who was wearing a sleeveless Bears sweater over a formal dress shirt and tie, off the field on their shoulders. "Mike Ditka epitomized football over so many years. He brought intensity, authenticity and an unmistakable personality to everything he did," NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell said in a statement. "As a Hall of Fame player, Super Bowl-winning coach with his beloved and iconic Bears, and as a broadcaster, Mike served as an ambassador for the game and inspired generations of fans."

item.title: 独メルツ氏、シュレーダー元首相に「憤り」 プーチン大統領の誕生会出席に
item.description:
Emanuele Berro Friederike Heine
[９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Emanuele Berro　Friederike Heine

[９日　ロイター] - ドイツ政府の報道官は９日、シュレーダー元首相がロシアのプーチン大統領の誕生日を祝うために自宅を訪問したことに対し、メルツ首相が「深い憤り」を抱いていると明らかにした。誕生会への出席は「完全に倫理に反すると見ている」と説明した。

報道官は「ウクライナ侵攻の責任はプーチン氏にある。命令によって計り知れない苦しみや民間人の犠牲、家族の分断、死傷者を生み出した」と強調した。南ドイツ新聞によると、シュレーダー氏が所属する社会民主党（ＳＰＤ）の共同党首で、連立政権の財務相を務めるクリングバイル氏も、誕生日を祝うための訪問は「全く容認できない」と述べた。

１９９８年から２００５年まで首相を務めたシュレーダー氏はロシアの経済界やプーチン氏と深いつながりがあるとして、ドイツ国内外から批判を浴びている。過去２０年間、石油会社ロスネフチなどロシア企業で複数の要職に就任。先週には、ロシアの小売企業の監査役会に加わった。

プーチン氏は以前、ロシアの欧州との安全保障対話の相手としてシュレーダー氏が望ましいとの見解を示したものの、欧州連合（ＥＵ）とメルツ政権は即座にこれを拒否している。

item.title: UAE says Omani flydubai co-pilot planned suicide attack on Tel Aviv flight
item.description: UAE public prosecutors say the plan was inspired by 9/11 attacks on the US. The suspect had used two previous flights to Tel Aviv to familiarize himself with the flight route and the airport.
item.dc:creator: Yasmine Ghania, Enas Alashray, Federico Maccioni
item.content:encoded: An Omani flydubai co-pilot had intended to [USN:L1N45M07P TEXT:"seize a Dubai-Tel Aviv flight"] and crash it into a terminal at Israel's Ben Gurion Airport on September 30 in a suicide attack before he was thwarted by the captain, the UAE attorney general said on Friday. Attorney General Hamad Saif al Shamsi's statement did not appear to implicate flydubai in any wrongdoing, and contained the most detailed account yet from prosecutors about what they believe to have happened. Flydubai was not immediately available for comment. The plan was inspired by the September 11, 2001, attacks on the US, UAE public prosecutors think, as a result of their criminal investigation launched on October 1. It found the suspect had used two previous flights to Tel Aviv to "familiarise himself with the flight route and the airport", the state news agency WAM reported. It is the first public confirmation of the co-pilot's 9/11 inspiration. The aircraft was in Saudi airspace when the co-pilot attacked the captain with a crash axe, typically kept in the cockpit for use during emergencies. The incident caused the airliner to [USN:L4N45Q00M TEXT:"plunge"] 16,000 feet (4,900 meters) in 30 seconds before the attacker was overwhelmed and two other pilots who were on board landed the aircraft safely in Saudi Arabia. The suspect was transferred to the UAE, flydubai's home country. SUSPECT MET PROFESSIONAL AND SECURITY REQUIREMENTS Investigators examined flydubai's recruiting procedures and found the suspect had met all professional and security requirements, including holding a pilot's licence and providing a certificate of good conduct. "However, none of the procedures revealed any indications of his extremist views or his intention to carry out a terrorist plot," Al Shamsi added. He said the 29-year-old had worked for airlines in different countries including Oman Air before joining flydubai in January 2026. The investigation found there were signs of the suspect drifting towards "extremism and terrorism" as early as 2017, while he was studying in Australia. Royal Air Maroc has said that he underwent three months of training there in 2025, but that his application to work for the airline afterwards was rejected. UAE officials have not identified the suspect; however, a person with direct knowledge of the matter told Reuters he had been identified as [USN:L1N45P01E TEXT:"Hammam al-Hammami"], an Omani national. Al Shamsi said the suspect had told investigators he had prepared psychologically and physically for the attack by viewing material promoting terrorism and taking boxing lessons. Saudi Arabia has launched a [USN:L1N45S12C TEXT:"separate safety investigation"] into flight FZ1073, sources told Reuters.

item.title: Vance says he won't watch livestream of execution; Trump remains silent
item.description: US Vice President JD Vance said on Friday that he would not watch a livestream of the military execution of the gunman who killed 13 people at Fort Hood military base in 2009, while President Donald Trump has yet to comment on the Pentagon plan.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Gram Slattery
item.content:encoded: US Vice President JD Vance said on Friday that he would not watch a livestream of the military execution of the gunman who killed 13 people at Fort Hood military base in 2009, while President Donald Trump has yet to comment on the Pentagon plan. "I don't know that that's actually going to happen," Vance told reporters while campaigning in Ohio. "If it's ultimately livestreamed, I'm not going to be watching it." Trump said at a White House event on Friday that former Army psychiatrist Nidal Hasan would be executed by firing squad. But he has not commented on the livestream plan announced by Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth on Thursday that has drawn [USN:FWN45V0WT TEXT:"criticism at home and abroad"]. Some Republican lawmakers and conservative strategists have criticized the decision. Republican US Senator Thom Tillis of North Carolina called the idea "beyond disgusting" in a social media post. "Public executions are what oppressive dictatorships like Iran and Afghanistan do," said the senator, a frequent Trump critic who is not running for reelection. "It should not be happening in America." Hasan is set to become the first person to be executed by US military firing squad since 1945. The execution is scheduled for December 3 at the same sprawling Texas base where Hasan opened fire with a handgun in a medical facility.

item.title: 日英欧加外相、ＩＣＣへの支持表明 米制裁受け共同声明
item.description: [ベルリン ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ベルリン ９日 ロイター] - 日本や英国、複数の欧州諸国、カナダの外相は９日、トランプ米政権が国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）本体に制裁措置を科したことを受けて共同声明を発表し、ＩＣＣに対する揺るぎない支持を表明した。

日英のほか、ドイツ、フランス、イタリア、デンマーク、オランダ、カナダの外相らは「制裁が実施されれば、ＩＣＣの活動、献身的な職員、その家族に重大な影響を及ぼすことになる」とし、「彼らは最も重大な国際犯罪で告発された者たちを法の下で裁き、被害者を支援するために尽力している」とした。

item.title: 米家計の所得・資産増加、債務ストレス拡大も＝22─25年のＦＲＢ調査
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン ９日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が９日公表した、２０２...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米家計の所得・資産増加、債務ストレス拡大も＝22─25年のＦＲＢ調査 1:26 配信

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）ビル。2025年9月撮影。REUTERS/Ken Cedeno

Howard Schneider

[ワシントン　９日　ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が９日公表した、２０２２年から２５年の消費者金融調査によると、新型コロナウイルス禍からの脱却に伴い、米国の多くの家計で所得と資産が増加したことが明らかになった。所得の伸びは低所得層に集中する一方、高インフレ期の債務負担の増加により、経済的ストレスを抱える家計の割合も拡大した。

ＦＲＢが３年に一度実施する同調査は、「緩やかな景気拡大とインフレ高止まりを背景に、多くの家計で所得と純資産が緩やかに増加した一方、経済的ストレスを抱えている家計の割合が拡大しているとみられる」と指摘。所得に対する債務返済比率が４０％以上の家計の割合は８．６％と６．５％から上昇し、２０１３年以来の高水準となった。

インフレ調整後の家計所得中央値は、同調査対象期間に７％増加し、８万２２００ドルとなった。これは、コロナ禍で逼迫していた労働市場が徐々に緩和され、失業率が小幅に上昇した時期にあたる。また、最も大きな所得の伸びが見られたのは所得分布の下位層で、特にサービス業で人手不足が深刻となり、企業が人材の確保・維持に向けて賃上げやボーナスを提供していたコロナ禍後の状況と整合した。

実質純資産の中央値は２％増の２１万５９００ドル。ＦＲＢは「純資産および所得分布を問わず、ほとんどの家計で増加がみられた」と説明した。

住宅所有率は約６６％で横ばいだった一方、株式市場への参加率は２２年の５８％から２５年には５６％へと小幅低下した。

所得格差はわずかに縮小し、全体として資産が広範に増加した一方、黒人世帯や低所得世帯の純資産は減少した。資産下位４分の１に属する世帯の純資産は３８００ドルから１７００ドルへと減少した一方、非ヒスパニック系黒人世帯は、平均純資産が約５％増加したにもかかわらず、純資産の中央値は２５％と大幅に落ち込んだ。ＦＲＢによると、この傾向は１３年以降続いてきた増加基調を反転させるものだという。

今回の調査は４３６７世帯を対象に、主に２５年４月から１２月にかけて実施された。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え コラム：何が豪ドルを動かしているのか＝高島修氏 コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 コラム：ドル／円の昨年高値更新に現実味、中立金利や介入効果に注目＝内田稔氏 コラム：9月ＦＯＭＣ、ドットプロット更新で金利見通しに波乱も 最終更新: 10/10(土) 1:26 ロイター

FAST

DOHA, Oct 9 : US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent will skip next week's annual meetings of the IMF and World Bank in Bangkok, Thailand, due to domestic engagements, a US official said on Friday.  The Treasury Department confirmed that Deputy Treasury Secretary Francis Brooke and Under Secretary for International Affairs Erin Browne will lead the US delegation for the department, with many pressing economic issues on the agenda.  Treasury said US officials would work with partners at the meetings to address policies and structural imbalances that have held back growth, while pushing for "more transparency and more effective approaches to sovereign debt." Bessent's absence from the high-profile financial event comes at a critical moment when benchmark Treasury yields have surged to their highest levels in nearly 25 years and the ongoing energy shock caused by the war in the Middle East has set back global growth.

It was not immediately clear what domestic engagements are keeping Bessent at home, but he has been a key spokesman for domestic economic policies as the midterm US elections approach. The US  also leads the Group of 20 major economies this year, and the Treasury chief would normally have chaired a meeting of finance ministers and central bankers from around the world. Bessent is expected to attend the G20 leaders summit in Miami, Florida, in December. It is not unprecedented for top officials to miss occasional meetings due to scheduling issues or other factors, but Bessent's decision may frustrate top officials from other countries, who generally use the meetings to secure formal and informal bilateral meetings with their US counterpart. Bessent skipped the G20 meetings in South Africa last year amid the Trump administration's objections to the country's land reforms and other issues. Treasury said the US delegation would focus on the debt issues so that countries facing debt distress could restore stability and return to growth, while creditors and borrowers are "held to clear and consistent standards." The US would also continue to press the International Monetary Fund and World Bank — where it is the biggest shareholder — to focus on their core mandates, operate efficiently, and support policies that promote economic stability, productivity and growth. "Our engagement in Bangkok will be guided by a clear objective: ensuring that the international financial institutions and the broader international economic system advance US economic and national security interests," Treasury said in a statement.

Source: Reuters

item.title: トランプ氏、ＦＲＢクック理事巡る調査委設置 解任理由の有無検証
item.description: [ワシントン ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ９日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のクック理事について、住宅ローンに関連して虚偽の説明を行った疑惑を調査する委員会を設置した。ホワイトハウスのウェブサイトに９日に掲載された通知で明らかになった。

通知は７日付で、「私が責務を遂行するのを支援するため、委員会はクック理事に対する疑惑を調査し、クック理事の解任に足る『理由（cause）』があるかどうかを私に報告する」としている。

委員会はクック理事に対する証拠と疑惑を検証するため、ホワイトハウスで対面による公聴会を開く。公聴会の所要時間は４時間を超えないとしている。

クック氏の弁護士は「提案されている手続きが真に公正なものとなる可能性があるのか、それとも単なる形式的な手続きに過ぎないのかを見極めるため、ホワイトハウスと協議してきた」とし、ホワイトハウスで開かれる公聴会が「少しでも客観的なら」、クック理事が住宅ローンに関する不正行為を行っていないことが示され、解任する根拠はないことが明らかになると指摘。「クック理事は自身の潔白を証明し、解任の法的根拠が存在しないことを示す機会を歓迎している」とした。

item.title: Trump says Russia to supply diesel to US and global markets
item.description: President Donald Trump said on Friday that Russia had agreed to supply diesel to global markets in an effort to lower fuel prices, and his administration temporarily lifted US sanctions on Russian fuel that were designed to deprive Moscow of revenues for its war on Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Timothy Gardner, Jarrett Renshaw
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump said on Friday that Russia had agreed to supply diesel to global markets in an effort to lower fuel prices, and his administration temporarily lifted US sanctions on Russian fuel that were designed to deprive Moscow of revenues for its war on Ukraine. Prices for diesel, used for agriculture, heating homes and trucking, are near a record and risk for Trump's fellow Republicans ahead of the November 3 congressional elections that will determine whether they maintain thin control of Congress. Diesel prices fell after the announcement, but analysts said the deal may not be enough to keep them down. Trump said on social media he had a "highly successful" discussion with President Vladimir Putin in which they agreed that Russia will immediately supply more than 300,000 metric tons of diesel to US and global markets, equal to about 2.25 million barrels of fuel. The US exports about 1.5 million barrels of diesel per day. After the call, an envoy for Putin, Kirill Dmitriev, praised cooperation between Russia and the US in a post on X. Dmitriev asked US officials during his visit to Washington last month for licenses to export diesel to the US market to be granted to all Russian major oil firms, sources familiar with the situation said. In October 2025, the US imposed sanctions on Russian oil companies over Moscow's war that began in 2022. The diesel exports could provide Moscow with billions of dollars in revenues that could help Putin continue the war with Ukraine. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy criticized the deal, announced while a Ukrainian delegation was in the US to discuss how to seek a resolution of the war, as a "weak decision on the part of strong partners." "Gifts to Putin will not bring peace or any benefit to the civilized world. Russia will 'repay' the diesel with further terror and perfidy," he said on X. The deal was also criticized by US lawmakers including Trump's fellow Republican, Representative Don Bacon, who said it is time to apply more sanctions that [USN:L1N4431OK TEXT:"Congress passed recently"], not lift the measures. "Now is the time to use those sanctions to squeeze Putin’s war machine, not reward a dictator by putting more money in his hands while he continues targeting and killing Ukrainian civilians," Bacon said on X. The US Treasury Department issued a license allowing importation of Russian diesel until April 7. Trump said Russia would supply another 500,000 tons in November and a further 1 million tons "immediately thereafter." Even more would follow, Trump said, "based on the condition of their diesel refineries," which have been damaged by Ukrainian attacks. 'NOTHING BURGER' Analysts said the agreement was unlikely to lead to sustained lower fuel prices. "I cannot overstate how much of a nothing burger this is," Rory Johnston, an oil market researcher and founder of CommodityContext.com, said on X, adding that Russia usually exports much more diesel than volumes in the deal when its refinery fleet is not under attack. "It's clearly not a fix, but another stream to aid a very tight diesel market," said Jim Mitchell, an analyst at consultancy Wood Mackenzie. [USN:L1N45U0FQ TEXT:"Diesel prices"], which are often a big driver of inflation, are up 70% since the US and Israel launched the war with Iran on February 28. The wars in Iran and Ukraine have triggered a severe global fuel supply crunch, pushing average US diesel prices to $6.28 a gallon on Thursday, according to the AAA motorist group. Prices have stayed high despite two recent moves by Trump to boost supplies of the fuel: pressuring allies to release emergency reserves and expanding access to tax-exempt red-dyed diesel, which is normally used for farm equipment. US diesel futures fell almost 5% following news of the deal and were trading at $4.64 a gallon. "Lower prices for Americans, especially our Great Farmers, Ranchers, and Truckers, is my Greatest Priority," Trump said. DEFENSE PRODUCTION ACT Three industry sources said earlier on Friday that Trump will issue a directive in the coming days to some US department heads to find ways to control diesel prices. The directive, which they said could take the form of a presidential memo, will push officials to find ways to bypass local and state regulations blocking energy production and use the Cold War-era Defense Production Act to increase output of oil and fuel. Under the DPA, the president can authorize US-backed loans or loan guarantees to expand domestic manufacturing of critical materials and to require companies to prioritize government contracts for essential goods. The White House has been weighing how to use the DPA to expand refining capacity as the war with Iran exposes US vulnerability to supply disruptions and price spikes. Refining executives [USN:L1N45214P TEXT:"told administration officials"] last month that federal money would be better directed toward making refineries more efficient or expanding plants rather than financing a new refinery, which would be more costly and take years to complete.

item.title: ＥＵ、ＩＣＣ機能維持へ必要措置講じる用意 米制裁巡り
item.description: [ブリュッセル ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ブリュッセル ９日 ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）の欧州委員会は９日の声明で、米国による制裁発動後も、国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）が活動を継続できるよう必要なあらゆる措置を講じる用意があると表明した。

米トランプ政権は９日、国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）本体に制裁を科した。

これに対し欧州委員会は、極めて遺憾だとの見解を表明。ただ、制裁の適用までに６カ月の猶予があるため、対話の余地は残されているとの見方も示した。

item.title: ベセント米財務長官、ＩＭＦ・世銀会合欠席へ 国内日程優先＝当局筋
item.description: [ドーハ ９日 ロイター] - 米政府当局者は９日、ベセント財務長官が１０月１２─１８日にタイのバンコクで開催される...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ベセント米財務長官、ＩＭＦ・世銀会合欠席へ　国内日程優先＝当局筋 0:35 配信

写真はベセント米財務長官。バージニア州マクリーンで2025年9月撮影。REUTERS/Brian Snyder

[ドーハ　９日　ロイター] - 米政府当局者は９日、ベセント財務長官が１０月１２─１８日にタイのバンコクで開催される国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）・世界銀行の年次総会を欠席する見通しだと明らかにした。国内日程を優先するためとした。

米財務省は、ブルック財務副長官とブラウン財務次官（国際問題担当）が同省代表団を率いると確認した。

財務省は、年次総会で米当局者らが各国パートナーと協力し、成長を阻害してきた政策や構造的な不均衡の問題に取り組むとともに、「ソブリン債に対する透明性の向上とより効果的なアプローチ」を推進していくと述べた。

item.title: Peso mexicano amplía baja tras Banxico; real sube tras sondeos electorales
item.description: Las principales monedas de América Latina cotizaron mixtas el viernes en una jornada de oscilaciones del dólar y de los precios del crudo, con las divisas de las principales economías de la región en sentidos opuestos, ya que el peso mexicano se hundió y el real brasileño avanzó.
item.dc:creator: Manuel Farías
item.content:encoded: Las principales monedas de América Latina cotizaron mixtas el viernes en una jornada de oscilaciones del dólar y de los precios del crudo, con las divisas de las principales economías de la región en sentidos opuestos, ya que el peso mexicano se hundió y el real brasileño avanzó. * A nivel global, el índice dólar repuntó tras un descenso de más temprano y marcó su cuarta alza semanal consecutiva, su racha más larga desde mayo de 2025; mientras que los precios del crudo cambiaron de tendencia y avanzaron ante la llegada del huracán Isaías, lo que provocaba cierres de producción en aguas estadounidenses. * En ese contexto, el peso mexicano se hundía cerca del cierre un 1,26%, a 18,4072 unidades por dólar, ampliando las fuertes pérdidas de la víspera, luego de que las minutas de la última reunión del Banco de México mostraron que tres miembros de su Junta de Gobierno señalaron que podrían considerarse futuros recortes en la tasa de interés en caso de mejorar las perspectivas inflacionarias. * Eso planteaba temores en los inversionistas por una posible ampliación de diferenciales con la tasa de interés de la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos. Los mercados esperan que la Fed aumente el costo del crédito en diciembre. El peso marcó su quinta semana de pérdidas. * "En 2026 el peso mexicano acumula una depreciación frente al dólar de 2,37% (...) y hoy el tipo de cambio tocó un máximo de 18,4985 pesos por dólar, no visto desde el 25 de noviembre del 2025. Desde el mínimo en el año de 16,8573 pesos por dólar registrado el 4 de septiembre, el peso acumula una depreciación de 9,36%", dijo Banco Base en un reporte. * La entidad dijo que la debilidad del peso mexicano en las últimas semanas se ha visto fomentada por la señal de recortes adicionales en la tasa de interés por parte de Banco de México; menos atractivo de operaciones por carry trade; el fortalecimiento del dólar a nivel global y una mayor percepción de riesgo sobre México. * Mientras, el índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, escaló un 1,63%, a 66.048,57 puntos. * En Brasil el real ganó un 0,76% a 4,9856 por dólar, para escalar un más de un 4% en la semana. El referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) trepó un 1,33%, a 209.017 puntos, según datos preliminares de cierre, para marcar un máximo histórico y también intradía. * Los mercados fueron apuntalados por recientes sondeos electorales de cara a la segunda vuelta entre el presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva y el senador de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro. * Los sondeos de Datafolha y de Atlas/Bloomberg daban como ganador del balotaje al senador Bolsonaro, quien venció en la primera vuelta, pese a que las encuestas apuntaban a una ventaja de Lula. Los mercados esperan que Bolsonaro aplique un mayor control sobre las cuentas fiscales del país. * El peso chileno , cerró con un retroceso del 0,27%, en 981,90/982,20 unidades por dólar, pero acumuló un avance semanal del 1,05%. Por su parte, el principal índice de la bolsa de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , clausuró la sesión con un alza del 0,17%, en 11.043,36 puntos. * El peso colombiano subió un 0,87%, a 3.189 unidades por dólar, y en la bolsa el índice accionario COLCAP (.COLCAP) ganó un 0,21%, a 2.531,15 puntos. * El peso argentino mayorista cerró estable a estable en 1.517 unidades por dólar para la venta. Desde el banco central (BCRA), entidad que regula la liquidez del mercado, se compró 69 millones de dólares el viernes y se acerca a acumular adquisiciones por 15.000 millones de dólares en lo que va del año. * "El BCRA mantuvo el ritmo de compras significativo que viene caracterizando a octubre", dijo Portfolio Personal Inversiones (PPI). * El índice líder S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires, en tanto, retrocedió un 0,16%. * La moneda peruana, el sol , finalizó con una leve baja del 0,03%, a 3,4430/3,4460 unidades por dólar, mientras que en la semana se depreció un 0,29%. En tanto que la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) escaló un 1,81%, a 1.602 puntos. * La economía peruana habría crecido en agosto a niveles "muy similares" a los de julio, cuando avanzó un 3,56% interanual, dijo el viernes el gerente de política monetaria del banco central, pese a los efectos adversos del fenómeno climático de El Niño. * Los mercados de Argentina, Chile y Colombia cerrarán el lunes debido a feriados locales.

item.title: 高市首相、「深く懸念」と投稿 トランプ米政権のＩＣＣ制裁に
item.description: [東京 １０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[東京 １０日 ロイター] - 高市早苗首相は９日夜、米国が国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）に制裁を科したことを受け、「日本の立場と相容れるものではなく、深く懸念している」とソーシャルメディアに投稿した。「我が国は国際社会における法の支配を一貫して重視し、その役割を担うＩＣＣを支持している」と改めて表明した。

トランプ米政権はＩＣＣに批判的で、赤根智子所長をすでに制裁対象としている。

高市氏は「赤根所長や関係国との意思疎通も継続しつつ、ＩＣＣがその本来の役割と機能を果たせるよう必要な支援を行っていく」とした。

トランプ政権によるＩＣＣ制裁決定に先立ち、ノルウェーのノーベル賞委員会は９日、同裁判所で判事を務めたナビ・ピレイ氏にノーベル平和賞を授与することを発表した。ピレイ氏は、イスラエルがパレスチナ自治区ガザでジェノサイド（集団虐殺）を行ったと結論付けた国連報告書の取りまとめを主導した。

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 9 : The euro was poised for a fifth straight weekly drop on Friday, with early gains fading as oil prices erased earlier declines, but recent selling pressure was muted as France's beleaguered bond market steadied. The euro zone's currency hit a 17-month low of $1.1161 on Monday as investors worried about France's record public debt and the difficult political path to budget cuts, in contrast with a robust-looking US economy and currency. The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies, rose 0.13 per cent to 102.25. The index was up about 0.3 per cent on the week and on track for a fourth straight weekly gain, its longest run since May 2025. The euro was last down 0.1 per cent at $1.1198, and off about 0.5 per cent on the week as it was poised for its longest streak of weekly declines against the dollar since the start of 2025.

Risk premiums on French and Italian government debt were on track for a weekly decline after jumping in late September, as investors looked for fresh developments before demanding higher compensation for fiscal and political risks. TRUMP SIGNALS NO IRAN ATTACK Global bond markets had calmed earlier on Friday as oil prices fell after US President Donald Trump said that the US would not attack Iran before US midterm elections on November 3 and added that there had been productive talks with Tehran over the war. "As it stands right now, you have a confluence of factors — you have higher oil prices, you have the issue in France, so it is really tough to say what is moving the market more than the other," said Eugene Epstein, head of trading and structured products at Moneycorp in Stamford, Connecticut. "But practically speaking, I'd say today is in a relative holding pattern, everyone is just waiting for all the Fed speak to make its way through, because certainly you can see that the sensitivity of the dollar is high to the entire range of Fed speakers now," Epstein said. Crude prices moved off their lows, however, as British navy-affiliated agency UKMTO said a vessel was struck by an unknown projectile 13 nautical miles west of Al Jazeera in the United Arab Emirates. US crude rose 0.6 per cent to $92.04 a barrel after falling as low as $90.01 and Brent advanced to $104.88 per barrel, up 0.58 per cent on the day, after declining to $102.33. Bond yields around the world have climbed in recent weeks due to expectations of central bank rate hikes as well as concerns about government finances. CENTRAL BANK POLICY IN FOCUS But expectations for a rate hike from the Fed at its policy meeting later this month remain subdued, with markets pricing in a 19.4 per cent chance for a rate hike of at least 25 basis points, according to CME FedWatch, even as recent economic data has pointed to persistent inflation pressure. However, investors are pricing in an 85.8 per cent chance for a hike at the central bank's December meeting. On Friday, the University of Michigan's Surveys of Consumers showed US consumer sentiment slumped further in early October as the rising cost of living because of the Middle East conflict soured households' views of the economy. While many Fed officials have indicated more rate hikes will be needed to curb inflation, others have pushed back on the need for immediate hikes, and suggested the Fed should be patient and flexible in deciding the rate path. French debt has been under pressure as politicians struggle to curb the budget deficit ahead of a divisive election in 2027. The calling of a snap election in Spain earlier in the week also added to the pressure on the euro. Sterling gained 0.08 per cent to $1.3235 but was on track for a seventh straight week of declines, its longest stretch since November 2024. Against the yen, the dollar strengthened 0.25 per cent to 158.25. The Japanese currency was on pace for its fourth straight weekly decline against the greenback, down about 0.2 per cent on the week.

Source: Reuters

item.description: Oct 9 : The US government said on Thursday it is suspending some major global tech and IT firms including Microsoft and Cognizant from a key green card program that allows skilled foreign workers to gain permanent residency through their employment. Senior US officials cited alleged fraud as the reason behind

FAST

Oct 9 : The US government said on Thursday it is suspending some major global tech and IT firms including Microsoft and Cognizant from a key green card program that allows skilled foreign workers to gain permanent residency through their employment. Senior US officials cited alleged fraud as the reason behind the move, saying companies have been using the program to replace American workers with cheaper foreign workers, and comes as the latest step in the Trump administration's crackdown on skilled foreign labor. WHAT IS UNDER SUSPENSION? The suspension is targeting a key employer-sponsorship mechanism, called the Permanent Labor Certification or PERM, which is used by major technology companies and outsourcing firms. The US government said that for certain companies, it would not accept any new PERM applications or process any pending ones.

PERM came into effect in 2005, aiming to speed up the long processing times experienced under the previous paper-based "Alien Employment Certification" program. Under PERM, the US Department of Labor (DOL) allows an employer to sponsor a foreign worker's permanent residency. The process is initiated by qualified US employers, and not individual workers. The Labor Department must certify to the US Citizenship and Immigration Services that there are not enough US workers that are qualified and available for a given job opportunity, and that the employment of the foreign worker will not affect the wages and working conditions of similarly employed Americans. Outside of PERM and family-based routes to permanent residency, individuals can also self-petition for green cards through processes such as the EB-1A application for individuals with extraordinary ability or the EB-2 National Interest Waiver. WHY IS IT IMPORTANT? The PERM program serves as a critical bridge between temporary work status and a green card for many foreign skilled workers. Many IT firms employ hundreds of thousands of workers who typically start on temporary work visas such as the H-1B, and later seek permanent residency. Without the option to be sponsored by their employer under PERM, foreign workers could lose a key route to permanent residency and would have to stay on temporary visas for longer. For companies, recruiting foreign talent could become harder, as many workers overseas view the path to permanent US residency as a key reason for taking a job. WHICH COMPANIES ARE UNDER SUSPENSION? The US said it is suspending Microsoft and Adobe along with some of the largest IT firms in the world, including Cognizant, Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, Wipro, HCL Technologies and Capgemini. Other companies such as Meta, Amazon or Alphabet's Google remain free to participate in the program. WHY IS THE US FREEZING APPLICATIONS? The move widens an ongoing crackdown on visas for foreign workers, which the Trump administration has said cost US jobs. Vice President JD Vance said, without citing specific evidence, companies are using the PERM program to replace American employees with foreign workers and undercut their wages. Vance said on Thursday: "Our message to Microsoft is: You're a great American company, but you've got to hire great American workers." The suspensions follow President Trump's move to impose a one-time $100,000 fee on new H-1B visa petitions for highly skilled foreign workers, which has been blocked by federal court orders. HOW IS PERM DIFFERENT FROM H-1B? H-1B is a temporary work visa that allows skilled foreign workers to work in the US, generally for up to six years. PERM, meanwhile, is a permanent labor-certification process. The freeze does not appear to directly affect current holders of H-1B visas. HOW CURTAILING PERM COULD BACKFIRE Some experts said that while the PERM suspensions might target specific companies, such policies risk making the US less competitive globally by deterring highly skilled foreign talent. "It is a fallacy to think that you can protect American workers by keeping skilled foreign workers out of the country. You think that foreign talent competes with Americans within our borders, they'll certainly compete with Americans by working abroad," said Chad Sparber, Director of the Lampert Institute for Civic and Global Affairs at Colgate University. Ahmet Gulek, Postdoctoral Fellow at Stanford’s Immigration Policy Lab, said that permanent residency is the primary way for talented foreign workers to stay in the country and without it, some will leave, and some will not come in the first place, even temporarily.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Wall Street anota alza semanal con atención puesta en ganancias corporativas y datos de inflación
item.description: Wall Street cerró al alza el viernes a medida que los inversores centraban su atención en la próxima semana, en que se inicia la temporada de resultados del tercer trimestre y se publicarán datos de inflación, que podrían arrojar luz sobre la próxima decisión de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: Wall Street cerró al alza el viernes a medida que los inversores centraban su atención en la próxima semana, en que se inicia la temporada de resultados del tercer trimestre y se publicarán datos de inflación, que podrían arrojar luz sobre la próxima decisión de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal. * Los tres principales índices bursátiles avanzaron en la sesión y registraron ganancias semanales. Sin embargo, el índice de empresas de pequeña capitalización Russell 2000 (.RUT) bajó. * "Es el tipo de mercado de vaivenes en el que nos encontramos, con cambios en el sentimiento respecto a Irán", dijo Ross Mayfield, analista de estrategia de inversión de Baird en Louisville, Kentucky. "Con noticias contradictorias provenientes de la Casa Blanca y de las partes involucradas en Oriente Medio, simplemente no hay una tendencia clara". * "Por eso es un repunte bastante tibio", añadió. * Los precios del crudo cayeron inicialmente, luego de que el presidente Donald Trump dijo que Estados Unidos no lanzaría ataques contra Irán antes de las elecciones de mitad de mandato, agregando que las conversaciones entre Washington y Teherán para poner fin a la guerra fueron "productivas". * La temporada de presentación de resultados del tercer trimestre comienza formalmente la próxima semana, con la publicación prevista de las cifras de los grandes bancos estadounidenses: Wells Fargo (WFC.N) , Goldman Sachs (GS.N) , Citigroup (C.N) , JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) , Bank of America (BAC.N) y Morgan Stanley (MS.N) . * Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) ganó 46,35 puntos, o un 0,60%, a 7.811,71 unidades; el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) subió 172,83 puntos, o un 0,64%, a 27.365,00 unidades; y el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) sumó 429,90 puntos, o un 0,84%, a 51.661,54 unidades. * Las acciones vinculadas a la inteligencia artificial registraron ganancias generalizadas, mientras el mercado alcista estadounidense, impulsado en gran medida por el auge de la IA, se acerca a su cuarto aniversario. * Mientras, la próxima semana se conocerán los datos del Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC) y del Índice de Precios al Productor (IPP), lo que podría arrojar luces sobre la medida qye podría tomar la Fed en su reunión de finales de este mes.

FAST

Oct 9 : EV-maker Tesla has started calling its "Full Self-Driving" feature "Tesla Assisted Driving" on its European websites, dropping a name regulators have said was misleading, as CEO Elon Musk pushes for EU-wide approval for the software. The rebrand comes after Germany said on Tuesday Tesla had offered to switch to the new name. Musk has described the self-driving technology as key to the company's future growth. Tesla's FSD page for Slovakia now redirects to a "Tesla Assisted Driving" page, as do pages in other European countries such as Germany, Spain and the Netherlands. The US site still refers to it as "Full Self-Driving (Supervised)." A Reuters report published this week detailed how Tesla mounted a campaign to win approval for FSD in Europe, including encouraging owners and supporters to lobby national regulators for faster approvals.

In September, a Norwegian Tesla owner asked the Norwegian Public Roads Administration whether Tesla's changes to how it described FSD addressed concerns about the name, according to documents Reuters obtained through freedom-of-information requests. "Please do not simply say again that 'we are waiting for the EU' without explaining what Tesla or Norway must deliver in the meantime," the owner said. Several regulators have said the old name is misleading because the system requires constant supervision and drivers remain legally responsible. In Sweden, consumer protection authorities had earlier asked the Swedish Transport Agency to assess whether the marketing of FSD could give buyers the false impression the system was capable of fully autonomous driving. In Italy, authorities had said in internal government correspondence that the name "Full Self-Driving", together with Tesla's promotional material, "could lead users to believe that the vehicle is equipped with unsupervised automatic driving functions attributable to higher levels of automation, particularly SAE Level 3", in communication seen by Reuters through freedom-of-information requests. Eight EU countries already allow the system, with Slovakia expecting to become the ninth within days. An EU-wide vote has been pushed from October to at least December, with countries like France conducting additional testing.

item.title: 米財務長官、中国担当顧問にシェルトン氏起用 元ＦＲＢ理事候補
item.description: [９日 ロイター] - 米財務省は９日、ベセント財務長官が、中国情勢を重点的に担当する顧問としてジュディ・シェルトン...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米財務長官、中国担当顧問にシェルトン氏起用　元ＦＲＢ理事候補 10/9 23:51 配信

2026年7月11日、米財務省庁舎。REUTERS/Daniel Heuer/File Photo/File Photo

[９日 ロイター] - 米財務省は９日、ベセント財務長官が、中国情勢を重点的に担当する顧問としてジュディ・シェルトン氏を起用したと発表した。同氏はトランプ米大統領がかつて連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）理事候補に指名した人物。

財務省によると、シェルトン氏は欧州復興開発銀行（ＥＢＲＤ）と全米民主主義基金（ＮＥＤ）を率いた経歴を持つ。インディペンデント研究所やスタンフォード大学フーバー研究所で研究員も務めた。

トランプ氏は第１次政権時、空席となっていたＦＲＢ理事にシェルトン氏を指名した。しかし、同氏の党派的と見られる姿勢がＦＲＢの独立性を損なう恐れがあるとの懸念が超党派で広がり、指名承認は難航した。

財務省は声明で「シェルトン氏は通貨政策について長官に助言し、特に中国の金融情勢の評価に重点を置く」と表明した。

TURIN, Oct 9 : Revolut plans to move beyond financial services and develop a broader suite of technology products, Chief Executive Nik Storonsky said on Friday, as Europe's most valuable startup pushes deeper into global markets. Storonsky said Revolut had developed proprietary AI models trained on customer transaction data, using techniques similar to those underpinning large language models. "With 30 to 40 million transactions taking place every day on Revolut, we have a unique dataset to build on," he said at the Wave by Vento tech forum in Turin, adding that his long-term goal was for Revolut to reach a scale comparable with the biggest US technology companies. Revolut's rapid growth has drawn regulatory scrutiny. In 2025, Lithuania's central bank imposed a record €3.5 million fine over shortcomings in transaction-monitoring controls, though the company said the investigation found no confirmed instances of money laundering and that it had strengthened its systems.

In September, Revolut accidentally sent customer data to hackers posing as government investigators. The company said its systems and customer funds were unaffected. Founded a little over a decade ago, Revolut was valued at $115 billion in a secondary share sale this year, up from $45 billion in 2024. It is now privately valued at more than the market capitalisation of Britain's Barclays or France's Societe Generale. The company has announced several new licences in recent weeks. It received preliminary approval for a national banking licence in the United States in September, after winning licences in Britain and France earlier this year. If Revolut were to list its shares, it would favor a primary listing in the US, Storonsky told Bloomberg TV on Thursday.

item.title: 米ミシガン大消費者信頼感、10月速報値46.3に低下 中東紛争の物価高響く
item.description: [ワシントン ９日 ロイター] - 米ミシガン大学が９日発表した１０月の消費者信頼感指数（速報値）は４６．３と９月の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ミシガン大消費者信頼感、10月速報値46.3に低下　中東紛争の物価高響く 10/9 23:44 配信

米ニューヨークのスーパーマーケットで2025年11月撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

[ワシントン　９日　ロイター] - 米ミシガン大学が９日発表した１０月の消費者信頼感指数（速報値）は４６．３と９月の４８．１から低下した。中東紛争に伴う物価上昇が、家計の景況感を悪化させていることを示唆した。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は４７．８だった。

１年先のインフレ期待は４．７％と、前月の４．６％から小幅上昇した。米国とイスラエルによる対イラン戦争が始まる前の２月時点では３．４％だった。

５年先のインフレ期待は３．５％。前月は３．４％だった。

消費者調査ディレクターのジョアン・スー氏は 「生活費を巡る不満は高まり続けており、政治的立場を問わず、消費者は年初から経済の見通しが弱まったと受け止めている」と指摘。「全体として、今月は低所得層や保有株式が少ない層の景況感が急激に悪化した。これらの層は物価上昇を乗り切るための余裕が少ない」と述べた。
